item.title: [Exclusive] People Power Party's Cho Kyoung-tae “Will Report Party Leader Jang Dong-hyuk to Ethics Committee Tomorrow” ([단독] 국힘 조경태 “내일 당 윤리위에 장동혁 대표 제소”)
item.description:
Cho Kyoung-tae, the longest-serving lawmaker of the People Power Party, decided on the 8th to report party leader Jang Dong-hyuk to the party's ethics committee. (국민의힘 최다선 의원인 조경태 의원이 8일 장동혁 당 대표를 당 윤리위에 제소하기로 했다.)

In a phone call with The Hankyoreh on the 7th, Rep. Cho said, “I plan to report Representative Jang to the ethics committee tomorrow.” He added, “After the defeat in the local elections, the party leader has not taken responsibility for it but is instead holding on, pushing the party into a more difficult situation. Representative Jang cannot evade responsibility for the local election defeat, including his comment that he would 'cut ties with those who advocate for cutting ties with Yoon Suk-yeol.'” (조 의원은 7일 한겨레와 통화에서 “내일 장 대표를 윤리위에 제소하려고 한다”고 말했다. 조 의원은 “지방선거 패배 이후 당 대표가 이에 책임지지 않고 되레 버티면서 당을 더 어려운 수령에 넣고 있다”며 “장 대표가 지방선거 국면에서 ‘윤석열과 절연하자고 하는 세력과 절연하겠다'는 발언 등으로 지방선거 패배 책임에서 벗어날 수 없다”고 했다.)

In February, Representative Jang stated, “The forces that are dividing the party by advocating for cutting ties with (former) President Yoon Suk-yeol are the ones we should firmly cut ties with.” (장 대표는 지난 2월 “(윤석열 전) 대통령과의 절연을 앞세워 당을 갈라치기 하는 세력, 단호하게 절연해야 할 대상은 오히려 이들”이라고 했다)

Rep. Cho announced that he would hold a press conference at the National Assembly's Communication Center on the 8th and then submit a disciplinary request to the ethics committee. Rep. Cho himself has already been reported to the ethics committee on suspicion of tarnishing the reputation of Vice Speaker Park Deok-heum during the election process for the People Power Party's deputy speaker candidate. (조 의원은 8일 국회 소통관에서 기자회견을 한 뒤 윤리위에 징계요구안을 제출한다고 밝혔다. 조 의원은 국민의힘 국회부의장 후보 선거 과정에서 박덕흠 부의장을 흠집 냈다는 의혹으로 윤리위에 제소된 상태다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party: "Muzzle Law Encourages Witch-Hunt Style Violence... Files Constitutional Petition" (국힘 “입틀막법, 마녀사냥식 폭력 조장…헌법소원 심판 청구”)
item.description:
On the 7th, the day the revised Information and Communications Network Act took effect, the People Power Party stated, "The 'Muzzle Law' is unconstitutional," and announced, "We will file a constitutional petition and push for a full revision bill as a party directive to remove the poison clauses." (국민의힘이 개정 정보통신망법 시행이 시작된 7일 “‘입틀막법’은 위헌”이라며 “헌법소원 심판을 청구하고 독소조항을 삭제한 전면 개정안 당론 발의를 추진하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Rep. Chung Jeom-sik, the floor leader of the People Power Party, said at a floor strategy meeting in the National Assembly, "The biggest problem with the Muzzle Law is that the state directly determines what is true or false, and what constitutes hate speech, and then punishes it." He added, "Depending on the interests of those in power, truth and falsehood will become entangled, and hate labels will be overused based on the whims of the powerful." (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 국회에서 원내대책회의를 열고 “입틀막법의 가장 큰 문제는 국가가 무엇이 사실인지 아닌지, 혐오인지 아닌지를 직접 정하고 처벌한다는 것”이라며 이렇게 말했다. 정 원내대표는 “권력의 이해관계에 따라 사실과 거짓이 뒤섞이고 권력의 기분에 따라 혐오 낙인은 남발될 것”이라고 주장했다.)

Chung argued, "Some politicians are already labeling an idol's single dialect word as 'Ilbe behavior.' The Muzzle Law will turn this kind of witch-hunt violence into everyday life and create a social atmosphere of fear and silence." He continued, "A society where the majority remains silent out of fear of censorship and labeling is a dictatorship. The People Power Party will protect the people's freedom." The revised Information and Communications Network Act primarily defines false and manipulated information beyond existing illegal content like pornography and bans its distribution. It defines content that is partially false or altered to be mistaken as fact as false and manipulated information under the law, and also includes information containing hate or discrimination as illegal content. However, due to the vague definitions of false and illegal information, there is strong concern in civil society about side effects that could stifle freedom of speech and the press. (정 원내대표는 “벌써 일부 정치인이 아이돌의 사투리 한마디에 ‘일베 낙인’을 찍고 있다”며 “입틀막법은 이런 마녀사냥식 폭력을 일상으로 만들고 공포의, 침묵의 사회 분위기를 조성할 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “검열과 낙인이 두려워 국민 다수가 침묵하는 사회가 바로 독재국가”라며 “국민의힘이 국민의 자유를 지키겠다”고 덧붙였다. 개정 정보통신망법은 음란물 등 기존 불법정보 외에 허위조작정보를 새로 규정하고 유통을 금지하도록 하는 것이 뼈대다. 내용 일부가 허위이거나 사실로 오인하도록 변형된 정보를 법상 허위조작정보로 정의했고, 혐오나 차별을 담은 정보도 불법정보에 포함하도록 했으나 허위·불법정보 규정이 모호한 탓에 시민사회에서는 언론·표현의 자유를 위축시키는 부작용을 우려하는 목소리도 거세다.)

Meanwhile, Rep. Chung also referenced suspicions that a current police officer—the father of Jang Yoon-gi (23), who murdered a female high school student—and the police who investigated the case had systematically covered up the crime. He proposed holding a consultative body among the ruling party, opposition, and government to discuss reforming the criminal investigation system. He urged, "Until the police fully restore public trust in their investigative capabilities, the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights should be halted. If it weren't for the prosecution's supplementary investigation, the truth might have been permanently covered up. We cannot leave criminal investigations solely to the police. Judicial reform should not be driven by the demands of hardline Democratic Party members but should proceed in a direction that enhances public safety and livelihoods." (한편 정 원내대표는 여자 고등학생을 살해한 장윤기(23)씨의 아버지인 현직 경찰관과 사건을 수사한 경찰이 조직적으로 범죄를 은폐했다는 의혹을 언급하며 범죄수사시스템 개편 논의를 위한 여·야·정 협의체 개최를 제안했다. 그는 “ 경찰이 범죄수사역량에 대한 국민 신뢰를 충분히 회복할 때까지 검찰 보완수사권 폐지는 중단할 것을 촉구한다”며 “검찰의 보완수사가 아니었다면 사건의 진상이 영영 은폐됐을지도 모른다. 범죄수사를 경찰에만 맡길 수 없다. 사법개혁은 민주당 강성당원의 요구가 아니라 국민의 안전과 민생을 보완하는 방향으로 가야 한다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Han Byung-do: “Criminal Procedure Act Amendment Including Complete Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Powers to be Proposed This Week” (한병도 “보완수사권 완전 폐지 담긴 형소법 개정안, 이번 주 발의 목표”)
item.description:
Han Byung-do, acting leader of the Democratic Party of Korea and floor leader, stated on the 7th regarding the Criminal Procedure Act amendment that will address the abolition of prosecutors’ supplementary investigation powers, “We aim to propose the Criminal Procedure Act amendment within this week, and we will accelerate in-depth and substantive discussions.” (한병도 더불어민주당 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 7일 검찰의 보완수사권 존폐가 담길 형사소송법 개정안과 관련해 “이번 주 내 형사소송법 개정안 발의를 목표로, 밀도 높고 내실 있는 논의에 속도를 높이겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Floor Leader Han held a floor strategy meeting at the National Assembly that day and said, “The complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers is a firm and unwavering principle of the Democratic Party, and there is no disagreement within the party.” He added, “We have already begun the drafting process, led by a ‘Criminal Procedure Act Amendment Task Force (TF)’ involving the chief of floor policy, deputy policy committee chair, judiciary committee secretary, and public administration and security committee secretary.” He continued, “There is talk about whether the amendment should be processed before Constitution Day or before the party convention (August 17), but we will move quickly without considering a specific timeline. While ensuring sufficient deliberation and debate, we aim to pass it as soon as possible to avoid any disruptions to the launch of the Prosecution Service and the Major Crimes Investigation Agency in October.” <<> Deputy Senior Policy Coordinator Kim Han-kyu also stated at the meeting, “We will prepare the Criminal Procedure Act amendment with essential content for the abolition of the prosecution office and the launch of the Prosecution Service and Major Crimes Investigation Agency on October 2, and we plan to propose it soon.” He added, “As already agreed at the party’s general meeting, we will abolish prosecutors’ supplementary investigation powers and include measures to check police investigations and protect victims, which may arise from this change.” He further stated, “After proposing the bill, we will discuss it in the Judiciary Committee and deliberate thoroughly within the party. We will also continue efforts to listen to public opinion.” <<> Meanwhile, the National Assembly’s Legislation and Judiciary Committee will hold a plenary session on the 8th to appoint members of the First Subcommittee on Bill Review, which will discuss the Criminal Procedure Act amendment, and also elect the chairperson of the First Subcommittee. <<> Jeong Hye-min reporter jhm@hani.co.kr Ko Kyung-joo reporter goh@hani.co.kr (한 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 원내대책회의를 열고 “보완수사권 완전 폐지는 민주당의 확고부동한 원칙이며, 당내 이견은 없다”며 “이미 원내정책수석, 정책위 부의장, 법사위 간사와 행안위 간사가 참여하는 ‘형사소송법 개정 티에프(TF)’를 중심으로 성안 작업에 착수했다”고 말했다. 이어 “개정안 처리도 제헌절 전이냐, 전당대회(8월17일) 전이냐 이야기가 있는데, 특정 시기를 고려하지 않고 신속하게 마무리하겠다”면서 “충분한 숙의와 토론을 거치되, 빠른 시일 내에 통과시켜서 오는 10월 공소청, 중수청(중대범죄수사청) 출범에 차질이 없도록 하겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: Wooden Box Mines, Leaf Mines... JCS “Beware of North Korean Mines Swept Away During Heavy Rain” (목함지뢰, 나뭇잎지뢰…합참 “집중 호우 때 북한 유실 지뢰 주의”)
item.description:
The Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) have urged caution, warning that when heavy rain falls in the border region between South and North Korea, mines buried by the North could be washed southward. (합동참모본부(합참)는 남북 접경지대에 큰비가 올 경우 북한이 묻어 둔 지뢰가 남쪽으로 떠내려올 수 있다며 주의를 당부했다.)

On the 7th, the JCS stated, “If heavy rain occurs in the border area, there is a risk that washed-out mines could flow in through rivers, so we urge the public to be cautious.” The JCS explained that many North Korean mines are buried in the Demilitarized Zone, and some mine-laying areas are connected to the Han River estuary through rivers shared by the two Koreas, such as the Imjin River, Hantan River, Hwa River, Bukhan River, and Inbukcheon. (합참은 7일 “접경지역 일대에 집중호우가 발생하면 유실된 지뢰가 하천을 통해 유입될 우려가 있어 국민 여러분들의 주의를 당부한다”고 밝혔다. 합참은 비무장지대에는 북한 지뢰가 많이 매설돼 있고, 지뢰 매설 지역 가운데 일부는 임진강·한탄강·화강·북한강·인북천 등 남북이 공유하는 하천을 통해 한강 하구로 연결되어 있다고 설명했다.)

The JCS requested, “When engaging in activities near shared rivers between the two Koreas, be careful of washed-out mines, and if you discover an unknown object suspected to be a mine, never touch it and report it to the nearest military unit or police station.” During past heavy rains, North Korean mines such as wooden box mines encased in wooden containers and leaf mines shaped like leaves have often drifted southward. (합참은 “남북 공유하천 인근에서 활동할 때 유실 지뢰에 유의하고 지뢰로 추정되는 알수 없는 물체를 발견하면 절대로 접촉하지 말고 가까운 군 부대나 경찰서에 신고해 달라”고 요청했다. 그동안 집중 호우 때면 나무 상자에 담긴 목함지뢰, 나뭇잎처럼 생긴 나뭇잎 지뢰 등 북한 지뢰가 남쪽으로 떠내려오곤 했다.)

By Kwon Hyuk-chul, Reporter nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae Targets Kim Min-seok's Premiership: "Party Leader Aspiration Remarks Are Self-Serving Politics" (정청래, 김민석 총리 때 겨냥 “당대표 로망 발언이 자기 정치”)
item.description:
Jeong Cheong-rae, former leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 7th, "I believe it is a prime example of self-serving politics that a sitting prime minister, who should focus solely on state affairs, caused a stir by making inappropriate remarks about having a 'party leader aspiration' that did not fit the time, place, or situation." This was a direct rebuttal to former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, who the previous day, while announcing his candidacy for party leader, criticized Jeong directly, saying, "Over the past year, the harm of self-serving politics has thrown the party and the party-government cooperation into confusion." <<> Former leader Jeong posted a message on Facebook titled "Now I Can Speak—Regarding Criticisms of So-Called Self-Serving Politics" and made these remarks. <<> The 'party leader aspiration' comments Jeong referred to appear to be Kim's remarks during a YouTube Sampro TV interview in January this year, where he said, "Being the party leader of the Democratic Party is a very proud position, so naturally, I have aspirations." <<> Jeong stated, "If someone claims that 'that person is engaging in self-serving politics,' they are attacking them for self-serving politics while actually doing it themselves." This is Jeong's argument that Kim's 'self-serving politics' remarks themselves constitute another form of 'self-serving politics.' <<> He further said, "After becoming party leader, I used a balanced approach in personnel appointments, placing people who were capable in the right positions even though they didn't help me during the party convention," and asked, "During my tenure as leader, I didn't give a single exclusive interview in print media—if I were practicing self-serving politics, wouldn't I have given numerous media interviews?" Jeong also noted, "During the local elections, I didn't push my own people," adding, "Whether someone close to me or distant from me received nominations through primaries, it was all the result of party members' choices." He described the one-person-one-vote system he introduced as a way of relinquishing power. <<> Jeong then asked, "Is the push for a merger with the Fatherland Innovation Party 'Jeong Cheong-rae's self-serving politics'?" and rhetorically questioned, "There are no 'ifs' in history, but if we had merged with the Fatherland Innovation Party, wouldn't the results of this local election and by-elections for parliamentary seats have been different?" He emphasized, "Others attack me for self-serving politics and creating discord with the Blue House, but I don't think so. I always advocated for the party-government-Blue House team unity and a single voice, and I carried that out in practice." <<> Jeong Hye-min Reporter jhm@hani.co.kr (정청래 전 더불어민주당 대표가 7일 “국정에만 전념해야 할 현직 국무총리가 TPO(시간·장소·상황)에 맞지 않게 ‘당대표 로망’ 발언을 함으로써 평지풍파를 일으킨 것이 대표적 자기 정치 사례라고 생각한다”라고 밝혔다. 김민석 전 국무총리가 전날 당대표 출마 선언을 하면서 “지난 1년, 자기 정치의 폐해가 당과 당정 협력을 혼선에 빠뜨렸다”고 정 전 대표를 직격한 것을 정면으로 반박한 것이다.)

item.title: South Korea, US, and Japan Foreign Ministers to Discuss Trilateral Economic and Security Cooperation at NATO… First Meeting in Nine Months (한·미·일 외교장관, 나토서 3국 경제·안보 협력 논의…9개월 만)
item.description:
The foreign ministers of South Korea, the United States, and Japan will hold a meeting on the sidelines of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) summit to discuss trilateral economic and security cooperation. Supply chain cooperation is also expected to be a key agenda item. (한국·미국·일본 외교장관이 북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 정상회담 계기에 회담을 열고 3국 간 경제·안보 협력을 논의한다. 공급망 협력도 주요한 의제가 될 것으로 예상된다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced that Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, and Japanese Foreign Minister Takeshi Iwaya will hold a South Korea-US-Japan foreign ministerial meeting on the 7th (local time) in Ankara, Turkey, on the occasion of the NATO summit. Deputy Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Lee Moon-bae explained, "In this first trilateral foreign ministerial meeting of the year, the three ministers will discuss issues related to the Korean Peninsula, regional and global situations, and security and economic cooperation among the three countries." (외교부는 튀르키예 앙카라에서 열리는 나토 정상회의를 계기로 조현 외교부 장관, 마코 루비오 미국 국무장관, 모테기 도시미쓰 일본 외무대신이 7일(현지시각) 현지에서 한·미·일 외교장관 회의를 개최할 예정이라고 밝혔다. 이문배 외교부 부대변인은 “올해 처음으로 개최되는 이번 한·미·일 외교장관 회의에서 3국 장관은 한반도 문제, 지역 및 글로벌 정세, 3국 간 안보 및 경제 협력에 대해 논의할 예정”이라고 설명했다.)

The trilateral foreign ministers' meeting takes place about nine months after their last meeting on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Gyeongju last October. With Japanese Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba absent from this NATO summit, a trilateral summit among the leaders is not possible, but the top diplomats of the three countries are expected to reaffirm the momentum for trilateral cooperation. In particular, they are expected to discuss ways to concretize trilateral cooperation projects related to energy and supply chains. (3국 외교장관 회의는 지난해 10월 경주 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의를 계기로 열린 뒤 약 9개월 만이다. 이번 나토 정상회의에 다카이치 사나에 일본 총리가 불참해 한·미·일 정상회의는 열릴 수 없는 상황에서 3국의 외교 수장이 한·미·일 협력의 동력을 재확인할 전망이다. 특히 에너지와 공급망 등과 관련한 3국 협력 프로젝트를 구체화하는 방안을 논의할 것으로 예상된다.)

Additionally, in the context of the winding down of the US-Iran war, issues such as freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, peace initiatives, and Middle East reconstruction could be on the agenda. Discussions may also include maintaining the status quo in the Taiwan Strait and other Asia-Pacific regional security matters. Furthermore, there is interest in how the three countries will express their concerns and condemnation regarding military cooperation between North Korea and Russia, as well as the level of references made to the goal of North Korea's denuclearization. (아울러 미국-이란 전쟁 종전 국면에서 호르무즈해협 자유 통항과 평화 구상과 중동 재건도 의제가 될 수 있다. 대만해협의 현상 유지 등 아시아·태평양 지역 정세 관련한 논의도 진행될 수 있다. 아울러 북한과 러시아의 군사적 협력에 대한 우려·규탄 표명과 함께 북한 비핵화 목표와 관련한 언급이 어떤 수준으로 표현될지도 관심사다.)

Meanwhile, a separate South Korea-US foreign ministerial meeting may also take place alongside the trilateral one. In that case, attention will focus on how South Korea-US security consultations, including on nuclear power and nuclear submarines, and the Coupang issue — which has been exacerbated by the US House of Representatives' unilateral "Coupang Defense Report" — will be discussed. (한편 한·미·일 외교장관 회의와 별도로 한-미 외교장관 회의가 열릴 가능성도 있다. 이 경우 원자력·핵잠수함 등 한·미 안보 협의와 최근 미국 하원의 일방적인 ‘쿠팡 두둔 보고서’로 심각성이 더해진 쿠팡 문제가 어떻게 논의될지도 주목된다.)

Senior Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Cheong Wa Dae: "Future Response Fund to Be Used for Youth Policies, Alleviating Polarization, Megaprojects, etc." (청와대 “미래대응기금, 청년정책·양극화 완화·메가프로젝트 등에 사용”)
item.description:
Cheong Wa Dae announced on the 7th that the newly established Future Response Fund, funded by additional tax revenue from the semiconductor boom, will be invested in key government policy tasks such as strengthening youth policies and alleviating polarization. <<> Ryu Deok-hyun, senior presidential secretary for fiscal planning, appeared on the YouTube broadcast "Cheong Wa Dae Fact Mill" hosted by senior presidential secretary for public communication and publicity, Seong Ki-hong, and cited △ youth and education policies, △ boosting the potential growth rate, △ alleviating polarization, △ balanced regional development, and △ megaprojects as purposes for the Future Response Fund. <<> Ryu mentioned the decline in the potential growth rate and the polarization issue, stating, "There are urgent tasks our government is facing." He added, "To effectively address these issues, you can think of us preparing through the Future Response Fund." He particularly emphasized strengthening youth support, saying, "How to show a future vision to the youth, who are the most vulnerable group, and how to implement policies and education for them are pressing issues. (The government) is preparing extensive youth policies concerning housing and jobs. Through the Future Response Fund, we are preparing to solve these problems." <<> Ryu noted that a special law is needed to establish the legal basis for the Future Response Fund, and the specific details of its use are expected to emerge around August. He said, "The fund should be established through a special law format," and "The allocation and budgeting process can only proceed through the National Assembly." He explained, "The government is scheduled to submit next year's budget proposal by the end of August. Since we need to include the specific details of (the Future Response Fund) around the time of the government's budget formulation, we aim to prepare swiftly and well." <<> Shim Woo-sam, reporter wu32@hani.co.kr (청와대가 7일 반도체 호황에 따른 추가 세수를 재원으로 신설되는 미래대응기금을 청년 정책 강화와 양극화 완화 등 정부 주요 정책 과제에 투입하겠다고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Audit Board: "Unfair Screening in Appointment of Kim Hyung-seok, Former Independence Hall Director Amid Historical View Controversy" (감사원 “‘역사관 논란’ 김형석 전 독립기념관장 임명 때 불공정 심사”)
item.description:
On the 7th, the Board of Audit and Inspection released audit results revealing that unfair screening occurred in the appointment committee for former Independence Hall Director Kim Hyung-seok in 2024. Former Director Kim caused controversy during his tenure due to distorted historical perceptions and allegations of privatizing the Independence Hall, leading to his dismissal in February. (2024년 김형석 전 독립기념관 관장 임명 당시 임원추천위원회(임추위)에서 불공정한 심사가 이뤄졌다는 감사원 감사 결과가 7일 나왔다. 김 전 관장은 임기 중 왜곡된 역사 인식과 독립기념관 사유화 논란 등으로 물의를 빚다가 지난 2월 해임됐다.)

The Board of Audit and Inspection disclosed the 'Audit Report on the Operation of the Independence Hall's Appointment Committee' containing these findings on the same day. (감사원은 이날 이런 내용을 담은 ‘독립기념관의 임원추천위원회 운영 관련 감사 보고서’를 공개했다.)

According to the audit results, the Independence Hall formed a seven-member internal and external appointment committee in February 2024, during the Yoon Seok-yeol administration, to appoint a new director. The committee recommended three candidates, including former Director Kim, to the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs. Despite having previously served as the director of a research institute affiliated with the 'Korea History and Future' foundation, where former Director Kim was chairman, Oh Young-seok, the then-chairman of the appointment committee, did not recuse himself and participated in document and interview screenings, claiming "the period of working together was less than a month." (감사 결과를 보면, 독립기념관은 윤석열 정부 때인 2024년 2월 새 독립기념관 관장 임명을 위한 임추위를 내·외부 인사 7명으로 구성한 뒤, 김 전 관장을 포함해 후보자 3명을 국가보훈부에 추천했다. 오영석 당시 임추위 위원장은 과거 김 전 관장이 이사장으로 있던 재단법인 ‘대한민국역사와미래’ 부설 연구소장을 지냈음에도, “(김 전 관장과) 함께 근무한 기간이 한 달 이내였다”며 회피 신청을 하지 않고, 서류·면접 심사에 참여했다.)

Regarding this, the Board of Audit and Inspection pointed out, "According to the Independence Hall’s internal regulations, if an appointment committee member and an applicant have a work experience relationship, it constitutes grounds for recusal." The Board also noted that the Independence Hall at the time only asked "committee members to submit a recusal form if they have grounds for recusal," without explaining or providing specific details about recusal grounds. For instance, one committee member had worked together with applicants 'A' and 'B' at the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs but submitted a recusal request only for applicant 'A', claiming 'no acquaintance' with applicant 'B'. (이에 대해 감사원은 “독립기념관 내규 등에 근거해 임추위 위원과 응모자가 근무경험 관계 등이 있으면 회피 사유가 된다”고 지적했다. 감사원은 또, 당시 독립기념관 쪽도 “(임추위) 위원들은 회피 사유에 해당할 경우 회피 신청서를 작성해 달라”고만 했을 뿐 구체적인 회피 사유 등을 설명하거나 안내하지 않았다고 지적했다. 가령 한 위원은 응모자 ㄱ, ㄴ씨와 국가보훈부에서 함께 근무한 경험이 있었지만, ㄱ씨에 대해서는 회피 신청을 하고 ㄴ씨는 ‘안면이 없다’는 이유로 회피 신청을 하지 않았다.)

The Board of Audit and Inspection notified the Independence Hall to "thoroughly handle related tasks to avoid unnecessary controversy over the fairness of the screening." (감사원은 독립기념관에 “심사의 공정성에 대해 불필요한 논란이 초래되는 일이 없도록 관련 업무를 철저히 하라”고 통보했다.)

Former Director Kim, appointed during the Yoon Seok-yeol administration, was a figure controversial for his pro-Japanese New Right historical perspective. After being dismissed in February due to allegations of privatizing the Independence Hall and misuse of business promotion funds, he has filed a preliminary injunction against the government. (윤석열 정부 당시 임명된 김 전 관장은 친일 뉴라이트 역사관으로 논란이 된 인물이다. 그는 지난 2월 독립기념관 사유화 논란과 업무추진비 사용 비리 등의 사유로 해임된 뒤, 정부를 상대로 집행정지 가처분을 신청한 상태다.)

The Board of Audit and Inspection also found that the '16 Unknown Independence Activists' project, commissioned by the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs as a service in April 2024, was poorly executed. This project was handled by the Korea History and Future foundation, where former Director Kim served as chairman. The list selected by this foundation included independence activists found in textbooks, such as Min Yeong-hwan (patriotic martyr during the Eulsa Treaty), Jo Man-sik (Product Promotion Movement), and Yi Sang-seol (Hague Special Envoy). The Board pointed out, "Highly recognized independence activists were selected, raising questions about rationality and causing controversy over the inadequacy of the research service." (감사원은 또, 국가보훈부가 2024년 4월 용역 사업으로 발주한 ‘16명의 알려지지 않은 독립운동가’ 사업도 부실하게 진행됐다고 봤다. 이 사업은 김 전 관장이 이사장으로 있던 재단법인 대한민국역사와미래가 맡았다. 이 법인이 선정한 명단엔 민영환(을사늑약 순국), 조만식(물산장려운동), 이상설(헤이그 특사) 등 교과서에 실린 독립운동가들이 포함됐다. 감사원은 “인지도가 높은 독립유공자가 선정돼 합리성에 대한 의문과 연구용역 부실 논란을 초래했다”고 지적했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Canada's Submarine Contract Blocked by 'NATO Alliance'... "Comprehensive Strategy in Diplomacy, Security, and Industry Needed" (캐나다 잠수함 수주 ‘나토 동맹’에 막혀…“외교·안보·산업 종합전략 필요”)
item.description:
As South Korea has failed to secure the contract for Canada's submarine project, worth up to 60 trillion won, experts point out that a strategy to overcome the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) barrier is necessary for future large-scale defense exports. (한국이 최대 60조원 규모의 ‘캐나다 잠수함 사업’ 수주에 실패하면서, 향후 대규모 방산 수출을 하려면 북대서양조약기구(나토·NATO)의 벽을 넘을 전략이 필요하다는 지적이 나온다.)

Hanwha Ocean competed with a German-Norwegian consortium for Canada's next-generation submarine introduction project, but the Canadian government on the 6th (local time) selected Germany's ThyssenKrupp Marine Systems (TKMS) as the preferred bidder. Following the announcement, President Lee Jae-myung posted on Facebook, "We did not achieve the expected results, but I believe we once again clearly demonstrated our potential to the international community." (한화오션은 캐나다 차세대 잠수함 도입 사업을 두고 독일·노르웨이 컨소시엄과 수주 경쟁을 펼쳤으나, 캐나다 정부는 6일(현지시각) 독일 티센크루프마린시스템스(TKMS)를 우선협상대상자로 선정했다. 결과 발표 뒤 이재명 대통령은 “기대했던 결과를 얻지 못했지만, 우리의 저력을 국제사회에 다시 한번 분명히 보여주었다고 생각한다”고 페이스북에 글을 올렸다.)

The presidential office, along with companies, devoted all efforts to securing the Canadian submarine contract. President Lee, during a summit with Prime Minister Mark Carney held on the sidelines of the G7 summit last June, stated, "South Korea, a defense powerhouse, is ready to actively contribute to strengthening Canada's security capabilities." Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik also visited Canada twice this year, in January and June, as President Lee's special envoy for strategic economic cooperation. (청와대는 기업들과 함께 캐나다 잠수함 사업 수주에 총력을 쏟았다. 이 대통령은 지난 6월 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 계기로 열린 마크 카니 총리와 정상회담에서 “방산 강국인 한국이 캐나다의 안보 역량 강화에 적극 기여할 준비가 돼 있다”고 말했다. 강훈식 대통령비서실장도 이 대통령의 전략경제협력 특사 자격으로 올해 1월과 6월 두 차례 캐나다를 찾았다.)

The Defense Acquisition Program Administration (DAPA) and Hanwha Ocean cited the 'NATO alliance' as the reason for the failure to win the submarine project. They noted that while South Korea was not inferior to its competitor Germany in terms of submarine performance and cost-effectiveness, it could not overcome the barrier of the 'Atlantic alliance.' (방위사업청(방사청)과 한화오션은 ‘잠수함 사업’ 수주 실패 원인으로 ‘나토 동맹’을 꼽았다. 한국이 잠수함의 성능·경제성에선 경쟁 상대인 독일에 뒤지지 않았지만, ‘대서양 동맹’의 벽을 넘지 못했다는 것이다.)

DAPA Commissioner Lee Yong-cheol told reporters on the 7th, "The (German) air-independent propulsion (AIP) battery, industrial cooperation, delivery schedule, and regional benefits were no different from ours." He added, "Decisively, the issue arose in the area of interoperability within NATO and even the possibility of sharing crew members." Weapons system interoperability refers to the concept of standardizing and enhancing compatibility among allied forces to share weapons, communications, and maintenance systems—it is a basic requirement among allied militaries. Hanwha Ocean also stated, "Despite the government's full support, our submarines' excellent performance, and the Navy's successful experience in operating submarines, we exerted every effort to win the contract but could not overcome the NATO alliance barrier." Hanwha Ocean previously failed to win a contract last November for Poland's new submarine project, losing to Sweden's Saab, a NATO member. (이용철 방위사업청장은 7일 기자들과 만나 “(독일의) 공기불요(AIP) 배터리, 산업협력, 납기, 지역 혜택은 우리와 차이가 없었다”며 “결정적으로 나토 간 상호운용성과 승조원 공유까지 가능한 협력 부분에서 발생했다”고 말했다. 무기체계 상호운용성은 외국 군대가 무기·통신·정비 체계를 함께 쓰기 위해 표준화·호환성을 높이는 개념인데, 동맹국 군대끼리는 상호 운용성이 기본값이다. 한화오션도 “정부의 전폭적인 지원과 우리 잠수함의 뛰어난 성능, 해군의 성공적인 잠수함 운용 경험을 바탕으로 수주에 혼신의 노력을 기울였지만 나토 동맹의 벽을 넘어서지 못했다”고 했다. 한화오션은 지난해 11월에 나토 회원국인 폴란드의 신형 잠수함 사업에서 나토 회원국인 스웨덴 업체 사브에 밀려 수주에 실패한 바 있다.)

Experts say that since the failure to win this submarine contract has confirmed the 'NATO barrier,' which is difficult to overcome with the competitiveness of the weapons alone, strategic defense diplomacy is needed to surpass it. (전문가들은 이번 잠수함 수주 실패로 무기 자체의 경쟁력만으로는 넘어서기 힘든 ‘나토 장벽’이 확인된 만큼, 이를 넘어설 전략적 방산 외교가 필요하다고 했다.)

Shim Soon-hyung, head of the Defense Industry Research Team at the Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade, stated, "Interoperability must be resolved by the government at a diplomatic level, while price-to-performance and required operational capability (ROC) must be precisely addressed by defense companies." A DAPA official said, "From Canada's perspective, after weighing whether to focus on the existing Atlantic strategic alliance or to expand into the Indo-Pacific and choose South Korea as its partner, it opted to strengthen the existing alliance." (심순형 산업연구원 방위산업연구팀장은 “상호 운용성은 정부가 외교적 차원에서 해결하고, 가격 대비 성능과 작전요구성능(ROC)은 방산 기업이 정교하게 풀어야 한다”고 말했다. 방사청 관계자는 “캐나다 입장에서는 ‘기존 대서양 전략동맹에 중점을 둘 것인가’ 아니면 ‘인도·태평양으로 새로 확장하면서 그 파트너로 한국을 택할 것이냐'는 고민 끝에 기존 동맹 강화를 선택한 것”이라고 말했다.)

Yoo Ji-hoon, a research fellow at the Korea Institute for Defense Analyses, said, "This failed contract is a case that shows large-scale defense exports are a strategic choice combining diplomacy, security, and alliance structures." He added, "For large-scale defense exports, it is necessary to comprehensively understand the target country's security environment, policy priorities, alliance structure, and industrial policy, and then pursue it as a national-level cooperation package." (유지훈 한국국방연구원 연구위원은 “이번 수주 실패는 대형 방산 수출이 외교·안보·동맹 구조가 결합된 전략적 선택임을 보여주는 사례”라며 “대형 방산 수출은 상대국의 안보 환경과 정책적 우선순위, 동맹 구조, 산업정책을 종합적으로 파악한 뒤 국가 차원의 협력 패키지로 추진할 필요가 있다”고 말했다.)

item.title: The Backlash against Jang Dong-hyuk's 'Disciplinary Politics'…Jo Kyung-tae "Refer to Ethics Committee" (막장 장동혁의 ‘징계 정치’ 역풍…조경태 “윤리위 제소”)
item.description:
Jo Kyung-tae, a six-term lawmaker and the most senior member of the People Power Party, has decided to refer party leader Jang Dong-hyuk to the party's Ethics Committee. (국민의힘 최다선 의원인 6선 조경태 의원이 장동혁 당 대표를 당 윤리위원회에 제소하기로 했다.)

Rep. Jo stated in a phone call with *The Hankyoreh* on the 7th, "The party leader is not taking responsibility for the defeat in the June 3 local elections; instead, he's stubbornly holding on, driving the party deeper into a quagmire." He added, "I will submit a disciplinary request against Leader Jang to the party's Ethics Committee on the 8th." The grounds for the disciplinary action cited include Jang's refusal to sever ties with former President Yoon Suk-yeol during the local election period and the controversy surrounding his trip to the United States just before the local elections. Rep. Jo, who has been calling for Jang's resignation, has himself been referred to the Ethics Committee for allegedly urging the defeat of Rep. Park Deok-heum, who was slated as a candidate for Vice Speaker of the National Assembly through an internal vote. <<> Earlier, at a closed-door meeting the previous day, Leader Jang stated, "For serious acts of misconduct against the party, we must revise the party constitution and regulations, if necessary, to permanently ban re-admission," intensifying his 'disciplinary politics' to quell calls for his resignation. The party's Ethics Committee held its first meeting after the local elections the previous day, reviewing over 70 agenda items received by the committee. Lawmakers from the pro-Han Dong-hoon faction who assisted independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon in his election campaign, as well as members of the "Alternatives and Future" group of young lawmakers calling for Leader Jang's resignation, are considered top priorities for disciplinary action. <<> The "Alternatives and Future" group also held a breakfast meeting at the National Assembly that day, pushing back against Leader Jang, stating, "If actions contrary to the perception of the majority of the people continue, we will not stand idly by." Concerns about the expansion of disciplinary actions are also emerging from the leadership in the National Assembly and the mainstream faction. Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik told reporters that day, "The decision to initiate disciplinary procedures, the targets and scope, and the severity of the punishment must be at a level that many party members, our lawmakers, and the people can accept." Rep. Na Kyung-won appeared on KBS radio and commented, "Wielding the disciplinary sword too harshly could become another source of division within the party." <<> Reporter Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr (조 의원은 7일 한겨레와 통화에서 “당 대표가 6·3 지방선거 패배에 책임지지 않고 오히려 버티면서 당을 더 깊은 수렁에 몰아넣고 있다”며 “8일 장 대표에 대한 징계요구안을 당 윤리위에 제출할 것”이라고 말했다. 징계 요구 사유로는 지방선거 국면에서 윤석열 전 대통령과의 절연 거부, 지방선거 직전 방미 논란 등을 들었다. 장 대표 퇴진을 요구해 온 조 의원은 내부 투표를 거쳐 국회부의장 후보로 내정된 박덕흠 의원의 낙선을 종용했다는 이유로 윤리위에 제소된 상태다.)

item.title: About 2.74 million ‘Olympic Ballot Papers’ Likely to Be Recounted… Han Byung-do Says “Will Actively Review in Special Committee” (‘올공 투표용지’ 274만장 재검표할 듯…한병도 “국조특위서 적극 검토”)
item.description:
The ruling and opposition parties reached a consensus on Monday regarding a recount of 2.47 million ballot papers from the June 3 local elections still held at the Olympic Handball Gymnasium counting hall in Songpa-gu, Seoul. The decision on whether to proceed with the recount will be made after discussions between the two parties within the ‘Special Committee on Parliamentary Investigation into the Ballot Paper Shortage’ (National Assembly Special Committee). (여야가 7일 서울 송파구 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장 개표소 내에 남아있는 6·3 지방선거 투표지 247만장에 대한 재검표에 대해 공감대를 이뤘다. ‘국회 투표용지 부족사태 국정조사특별위원회(국조특위)’에서 여야 논의를 거쳐 재검표 시행 여부를 결정할 예정이다.)

Han Byung-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said at a party floor strategy meeting that day, “The Democratic Party will actively review pushing for a recount and manual inspection of the remaining 2.47 million ballot papers at the Olympic Handball Gymnasium through bipartisan consultations within the Special Committee.” This came after Yoon Sang-hyun, a member of the People Power Party and chair of the Special Committee, proposed a recount to the National Election Commission on Friday, saying, “Let's publicly re-verify those 2.47 million votes to show that there was no wrongdoing in the voting and counting process.” (한병도 더불어민주당 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 이날 국회 원내대책회의에서 “민주당은 올림픽공원 핸드볼 경기장에 남은 투표지 247만장에 대한 재검표와 수개표를 여야 협의를 통해 국조특위에서 추진하는 방안을 적극 검토하겠다”고 말했다. 지난 5일 국민의힘 소속 윤상현 국조특위 위원장은 “247만표를 공개적으로 재검증해 잘못된 투개표가 없었다는 것을 보여달라”며 선관위에 재검표를 제안했는데 이날 민주당이 화답한 것이다.)

The National Election Commission (NEC) also stated that a recount through a resolution of the Special Committee is necessary. During the second on-site inspection of the Special Committee at the NEC headquarters in Gwacheon, Gyeonggi Province, the NEC reported, “To restore the function of the Olympic Handball Gymnasium (Songpa counting hall) and to alleviate public anxiety and suspicions, the transfer of ballot papers is necessary. Prior to the transfer, a separate verification is needed.” The NEC estimated that recounting the 2.47 million papers would require 440 personnel, a budget of 50 million won, and approximately nine hours. (중앙선거관리위원회도 국조특위 의결을 통한 재검표가 필요하다는 입장을 밝혔다. 이날 경기도 과천 중앙선관위에서 진행된 국조특위 2차 현장 조사에서 중앙선관위는 “올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장(송파구 개표소) 기능을 원상복구하고, 국민적 불안감과 의혹을 해소하기 위해 투표지 등의 이송이 필요하다. 이송에 앞서 별도의 검증이 필요하다”고 보고했다. 중앙선관위는 247만장 재검표에 인력 440명, 예산 5천만원이 필요하고 9시간이 소요될 것이라고 밝혔다.)

In response, Chair Yoon stated, “A public recount is a way to resolve distrust in the NEC and a minimal measure of inclusion for the citizens at Olympic Park.” However, Lee Jun-seok, a lawmaker from the Reform Party, expressed concern, saying, “Those who claim election fraud will doubt the recount. If a political recount process is carried out, people might ask, ‘Why did you do this?’.” (이에 윤 위원장은 “공개 재검표는 선관위에 대한 불신을 해소하는 방안이고, 올림픽공원에 있는 시민들에 대한 최소한의 포용 조치”라고 했다. 다만 이준석 개혁신당 의원은 “부정선거론자들은 (재검표를) 다 의심한다. 정치적인 재검표 절차를 진행한다면 ‘이거 왜 했냐’고 나올 수 있다”는 우려를 보였다.)

Ultimately, the decision on the recount will be made through internal coordination within each party followed by consultations between the floor leaders of the ruling and opposition parties in the Special Committee. Chair Yoon said, “We will consult with the floor leaders and also discuss with the NEC.” (결국 재검표 여부는 각 당 내부 조율을 거쳐 국조특위 여야 간사 간 협의를 통해 결정하기로 했다. 윤 위원장은 “여야 간사 간 협의하고, 중앙선관위와도 논의해보겠다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, the Special Committee decided that day to summon a total of 97 witnesses for the first hearing, scheduled for the 14th, including all NEC commissioners as well as officials from the Ministry of the Interior and Safety and the police. (한편, 이날 국조특위는 오는 14일 1차 청문회에 중앙선거관리위원 전원을 포함해 행정안전부·경찰 관계자 등 총 97명을 증인으로 부르기로 했다.)

Reporters: Ko Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr, Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr 유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Exclusive] 690 Election Appeals, 15 Times More Than Local Elections 4 Years Ago…87.5% Due to ‘Shortage of Ballot Papers’ ([단독] 선거소청 690건, 4년 전 지방선거 15배…‘투표용지 부족’이 87.5%)
item.description:
A total of 690 election appeals disputing the results of the June 3 local elections have been filed, marking a 15-fold increase compared to the 2022 local elections, with 87.5% of these appeals found to be due to a shortage of ballot papers. (6·3 지방선거 결과에 불복하며 제기한 선거소청 건수가 총 690건으로 지난 2022년 지방선거에 비해 15배 증가한 가운데, 이중 87.5%가 투표용지 부족으로 인한 소청으로 밝혀졌다.)

According to the ‘Detailed Report on Election Appeals for the 9th National Simultaneous Local Elections’ obtained by The Hankyoreh on the 7th, out of the total 690 appeals, 604 cases (87.5%) cited the ‘ballot paper shortage incident’ as the reason for the appeal. Other reasons included 61 cases regarding suspicions of electoral fraud, 5 cases of defects in the voting and counting management process, 5 cases related to candidate registration qualifications, 3 requests for a recount due to narrow vote margins, 1 case related to illegal election campaigning, and 9 other cases. (한겨레가 7일 입수한 중앙선거관리위원회의 ‘제9회 전국동시지방선거 선거소청 세부내역 보고서’를 보면, 전체 소청건수 690건 중 87.5%에 달하는 604건이 ‘투표용지 부족 사태’를 소청 이유로 제시했다. 이밖에 부정선거 의혹 61건, 투개표관리절차 하자 5건, 후보자 등록자격 관련 5건, 근소표차로 인한 재검표 요구 3건, 불법 선거운동 관련 1건, 기타 9건 등이었다.)

An election appeal is a procedure for disputing the validity of an election, either due to the election results or irregularities in the election process. It can be filed by voters, candidates, or political parties that recommended a candidate within two weeks of election day with the relevant election commission. (선거소청은 선거 결과나 선거 과정의 위법·부당함에 불복해 선거 효력에 이의를 제기하는 절차다. 선거인(유권자), 후보자, 후보자를 추천한 정당이 선거일로부터 2주 이내 관할 선관위에 제기할 수 있다.)

The number of election appeals, which was only 11 during the 2018 local elections, surged sharply to 45 in 2022 and 690 in 2026. This reflects a significant increase in voters and candidates disputing election results. (지난 2018년 지방선거 당시 11건에 불과하던 선거소청 건수는 2022년 45건, 2026년 690건으로 가파르게 증가했다. 선거 결과에 불복하는 유권자와 후보자가 크게 늘어난 것이다.)

The main reasons for the increase are largely the ballot paper shortage incident and suspicions of electoral fraud. According to the collection of election appeal decisions published by the National Election Commission (NEC), election appeals citing suspicions of electoral fraud, such as ‘differences in voter turnout between early voting and election day voting,’ began to emerge in earnest from 2022. Statistics from 2022 show that out of 45 total appeals, 32 were related to electoral fraud suspicions, 5 requests for a recount due to narrow vote margins, 2 cases related to candidate registration qualifications, 4 cases of illegal campaigning and other unlawful acts, and 2 other cases. In 2018, out of 11 total appeals, there were 3 cases related to election management such as voting and counting, 4 cases related to candidate registration qualifications, 3 requests for a recount due to narrow vote margins, and 1 case related to illegal election campaigning. (증가 사유는 대부분 투표용지 부족 사태, 부정선거 의혹 등이다. 중앙선관위가 발간한 선거소청결정문집을 보면, ‘사전투표와 선거일투표의 득표율 차이’ 등 부정선거 의혹으로 인한 선거소청은 2022년부터 본격적으로 등장하기 시작한다. 2022년 소청 통계를 보면, 전체 45건 중 부정선거 의혹이 32건, 근소표차에 의한 재검표 요구 5건, 후보자 등록자격 관련 2건, 불법 선거운동 등 위법행위 4건, 기타 2건이었다. 2018년에는 전체 11건 중 투개표 등 선거관리 관련 3건, 후보자 등록자격 관련 4건, 근소표차로 인한 재검표 요구 3건, 불법 선거운동 관련 1건 등이다.)

An NEC official said in a phone call with The Hankyoreh, “While previously, requests for a recount due to narrow vote margins were common, election appeals due to electoral fraud have sharply increased starting in 2022,” adding, “However, not a single one of those appeals was actually upheld.” He further stated, “Given that the ballot paper shortage incident erupted in this local election, we understand that many related appeals have been filed,” and “We will proceed with the (appeal review, etc.) procedures in accordance with the legal requirements as much as possible.” (중앙선관위 관계자는 한겨레와 통화에서 “이전까지는 근소표차로 인한 재검표 요구 등이 주였다면, 2022년부터 부정선거로 인한 선거소청이 급증하기 시작했다”며 “그중 실제로 인용된 소청은 한 건도 없었다”고 말했다. 또 “이번 지선에서는 투표용지 부족 사태가 불거진 만큼 관련 소청이 많이 있는 것으로 이해한다”며 “최대한 법이 정한 요건에 맞춰 (소청심사 등) 절차를 진행할 예정”이라고 말했다.)

Once an appeal is filed, the NEC’s Appeal Review Committee makes a decision within 60 days. If the NEC accepts the appeal, a by-election is held within 30 days of the notification of the decision. If the appeal is dismissed or rejected, the person who filed the appeal can challenge the decision again in court. (소청이 접수되면 선관위 소청심사위에서 60일 내 소청에 대한 결정을 내린다. 선관위가 소청을 받아들이면 결정 통지일로부터 30일 이내에 재선거를 실시하며, 기각·각하될 경우 소청을 낸 사람이 다시 법원에 이의를 제기할 수 있다.)

Reporter Ko Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party Says "Poisonous Clauses Must Be Removed" as Network Act Takes Effect, Democratic Party Says "Halt False and Manipulated Information" (정통망법 시행에 국힘 “독소조항 삭제해야”…민주 “허위조작정보 막아야”)
item.description:
Regarding the amended Information and Communications Network Act that took effect on the 7th, the People Power Party (PPP) stated, "We will file a constitutional complaint and push for a party-proposed full revision bill that removes poisonous clauses." The Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) countered that the PPP is distorting the facts, arguing that "the amended law is a minimal mechanism to hold false and manipulated information accountable." (국민의힘이 7일 시행된 개정 정보통신망법에 대해 “헌법소원 심판을 청구하고 독소조항을 삭제한, 전면 개정안 당론 발의를 추진하겠다”고 밝혔다. 더불어민주당은 “개정법은 허위조작정보에 책임을 묻는 최소한의 장치”라며 국민의힘이 사실을 왜곡하고 있다고 반박했다.)

PPP floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik held a floor strategy meeting at the National Assembly on the same day and, targeting the amended Act, said, "The 'gag law' is a bad law and unconstitutional." He claimed, "The biggest problem with the gag law is that the state itself decides what is true or not, what is hate speech or not, and punishes accordingly. Fact and falsehood will become mixed depending on the interests of power, and hate labels will be recklessly applied depending on the mood of those in power." (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 원내대책회의를 열고 개정 정보통신망법을 겨냥해 “입틀막법은 악법이고, 위헌이다”라고 말했다. 정 원내대표는 “입틀막법의 가장 큰 문제는 국가가 무엇이 사실인지 아닌지, 혐오인지 아닌지를 직접 정하고 처벌한다는 것”이라며 “권력의 이해관계에 따라 사실과 거짓이 뒤섞이고 권력의 기분에 따라 혐오 낙인은 남발될 것이다”라고 주장했다.)

The core of the amended Information and Communications Network Act is the imposition of punitive damages up to five times the amount of damages for the intentional distribution of false or manipulated information online. While its aim is to eradicate the harms of illegal and false/manipulated information, concerns have been raised that the ambiguous definitions of such information could stifle press and expression freedoms. (개정 정보통신망법은 온라인상 허위조작정보를 고의로 유통할 경우 손해액의 최대 5배까지 징벌적 손해배상을 부과하는 내용을 뼈대로 한다. 불법·허위조작정보의 폐해를 근절하려는 취지지만, 허위조작정보 등의 규정이 모호해 언론과 표현의 자유를 위축시킬 수 있다는 우려도 나온다.)

The DPK refuted the PPP, stating, "They are distorting the facts as if this law is a tool of government censorship." DPK acting leader and floor leader Han Byeong-do said at the party's floor strategy meeting, "The amended Information and Communications Network Act is a minimal institutional mechanism to prevent the production and distribution of false/manipulated information and to hold people accountable accordingly. Where is there a gag law or dictatorship?" DPK Communications Committee Chair Rep. Kim Hyun also held a press conference on the same day, stating, "Deliberately creating false information knowing it is false and repeatedly spreading it to harm individuals and society cannot be protected under the name of freedom of expression." (민주당은 국민의힘을 향해 “이 법을 정부의 검열 도구인 것처럼 사실을 왜곡하고 있다”고 반박했다. 한병도 민주당 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 이날 국회 원내대책회의에서 “개정된 정보통신망법은 허위조작정보의 생산과 유포를 막고, 그에 상응하는 책임을 묻기 위한 최소한의 제도적 장치”라며 “어디에 입틀막과 독재가 있느냐”고 했다. 민주당 국민소통위원장인 김현 의원도 이날 기자회견을 열고 “거짓이라는 사실을 알면서도 의도적으로 허위정보를 만들고 이를 반복적으로 퍼뜨려 개인과 사회에 피해를 주는 행위는 표현의 자유라는 이름으로 보호받을 수 없다”고 했다.)

Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr Reporter Ko Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party Announces Submitting 2nd Comprehensive Special Counsel Bill to Extend Investigation Period at Judiciary Committee Tomorrow (민주 “내일 법사위서 ‘수사기간 연장’ 2차 종합특검법 개정안 상정”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea announced on the 7th that it will proceed with the legislative process for an amendment to the Special Counsel Act to extend the investigation period and increase the number of dispatched officials for the special counsel team led by Kwon Chang-young, which handles the remaining cases of the three major special counsels (insurrection, Kim Keon-hee, and the Marine's death in the line of duty), in accordance with National Assembly procedures. (더불어민주당이 3대 특검(내란·김건희·순직해병대원 특검) 잔여 사건을 수사하는 권창영 특별검사팀의 수사 기간을 연장하고 파견 공무원 숫자를 늘리는 특검법 개정안을 국회법 절차에 따라 진행하겠다고 7일 밝혔다.)

Rep. Kim Seong-hoe, the floor spokesperson, stated in a written briefing, "Special Counsel Kwon Chang-young has requested the National Assembly to amend the Special Counsel Act," adding, "The National Assembly Legislation and Judiciary Committee will hold a plenary session tomorrow (7th) to submit the amendment to the comprehensive Special Counsel Act based on the first-in, first-out principle." (김성회 원내대변인은 이날 서면 브리핑을 내어 “권창영 종합특검이 국회에 특별검사법의 개정을 요청했다”며 “국회 법제사법위원회는 내일(7일) 전체회의를 열고 선입선출원칙에 따라 종합특검법 개정안을 상정할 예정”이라고 말했다.)

Rep. Kim further stated, "The reason the comprehensive special counsel requested the amendment is to ensure a thorough investigation into the facts and efficient prosecution," adding, "The 2nd comprehensive Special Counsel Act amendment regarding Yoon Seok-youl and Kim Keon-hee was already proposed last March and referred to the Legislation and Judiciary Committee last April." (김 원내대변인은 “종합특검이 개정을 요청한 이유는 사건의 철저한 진상규명과 효율적인 공소유지를 위함”이라며 “윤석열·김건희 2차 종합특검법 개정안은 이미 지난 3월에 발의된 법안이고, 지난 4월 법사위에 회부된 바 있다”고 했다.)

Rep. Kim continued, "The People Power Party is claiming that the Democratic Party is unilaterally amending the law by holding the chairmanship of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee," and asked, "How long will you continue to obstruct with strained logic and tantrums? If you have even a shred of decency, I hope you will at least come to the standing committee and participate in discussions on the bill." (김 원내대변인은 이어 “국민의힘은 민주당이 법사위원장직을 쥐고 법 개정을 멋대로 한다고 주장하고 있다”며 “언제까지 억지 논리와 생떼로 어깃장만 놓을 셈인가. 최소한의 염치가 있다면, 적어도 상임위에 들어와 법안 논의에 참여하길 바란다”고 했다.)

The 2nd comprehensive special counsel team led by Kwon Chang-young submitted a request to amend the Special Counsel Act to extend the investigation period by an additional 30 days to National Assembly Legislation and Judiciary Committee Chairman Seo Young-kyo on the 1st. The special counsel team also reportedly requested that special investigators with attorney qualifications be allowed to handle prosecution duties and that the quota of dispatched officials be increased. (권창영 2차 종합특검팀은 지난 1일 서영교 국회 법제사법위원장에게 수사 기한을 30일 더 연장해달라는 특검법 개정 요청서를 제출한 바 있다. 특검팀은 또한 변호사 자격이 있는 특별수사관이 공소유지 업무를 맡을 수 있도록 하고, 파견 공무원의 정원을 늘려달라는 요청도 한 것으로 전해졌다.)

By Koh Han-sol, Reporter sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae Counterattacks: "PM Kim Engaging in Self-Politics"... Kim Min-seok: "Time to Assess the Harm of the Past Year" (정청래 “김 총리가 자기 정치” 역공…김민석 “1년 폐해 평가할 시간”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok, a former prime minister and candidate for party leader in the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 national convention, and Jung Cheong-rae, a former representative, clashed head-on on the 7th, engaging in a so-called 'self-politics' spat against each other. On this day, the Democratic Party's National Convention Preparatory Committee (NCPC) decided to hold the party leadership election using a 'preferential voting' system rather than a 'runoff vote.' (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거 주자인 김민석 전 총리와 정청래 전 대표가 7일 서로를 향해 이른바 ‘자기 정치’ 공방을 벌이면서 정면충돌했다. 이날 민주당 전당대회준비위원회(전준위)는 당대표 선거를 ‘결선투표’가 아닌 ‘선호투표’ 방식으로 치르기로 했다.)

Kim and Jung's 'Self-Politics' Clash (김-정 ‘자기 정치’ 충돌)

On this day, former Representative Jung wrote on Facebook, "It is a prime example of self-politics for a sitting Prime Minister, who should focus solely on state affairs, to stir up a storm by making a 'party leader dream' remark that was inappropriate for the TPO (time, place, and occasion)." He also said, "Are those attacking me 100% only engaged in 'others' politics'?" This referred to former Prime Minister Kim's comment in a January interview with YouTube channel Sampro TV that he "has a dream of becoming party leader," and was a rebuttal to Kim's 'self-politics' criticism from the previous day. Former Prime Minister Kim had criticized former Representative Jung, saying, "Over the past year, the harm of self-politics has thrown the party and party-government cooperation into confusion." (이날 정 전 대표는 페이스북에 “국정에만 전념해야 할 현직 국무총리가 티피오(TPO: 시간과 장소, 상황)에 맞지 않게 ‘당대표 로망’ 발언을 함으로써 평지풍파를 일으킨 것이 대표적 자기 정치 사례”라고 썼다. 그는 “저를 공격하시는 분은 100% ‘남의 정치’만 했느냐”고도 했다. 김 전 총리가 지난 1월 유튜브 삼프로티브이(TV)와 한 인터뷰에서 “당대표직에 로망이 있다”고 했던 것을 문제 삼은 것으로, 전날 김 전 총리의 ‘자기 정치’ 공격에 대한 반박 성격이다. 김 전 총리는 “지난 1년, 자기 정치의 폐해가 당과 당정 협력을 혼선에 빠트렸다”고 정 전 대표를 비판한 바 있다.)

Former Prime Minister Kim also responded. Meeting with reporters at the National Assembly on this day, Kim said, "Former Representative Jung's reply has brought up the key issue of 'what kind of self-politics needs to be overcome,'" adding, "The time has come to discuss and evaluate the harm of self-politics that has caused difficulties for the party over the past year." (김 전 총리도 재응수했다. 김 전 총리는 이날 국회에서 기자들을 만나 “정 전 대표의 화답으로 ‘어떤 게 극복해야 할 자기 정치인가’가 중요한 주제로 올라왔다”며 “지난 1년 당에 어려움을 가져온 자기 정치 폐해에 대해 토론하고 평가할 시간이 돌아왔다”고 말했다.)

Candidates for the Supreme Council positions are also engaged in a proxy war over the party leadership election. Lawmaker Lee Geon-tae, close to former Prime Minister Kim, declared his candidacy for the Supreme Council on this day, saying, "Former Representative (Jung) created discord with the (government) out of his greed for self-politics." Lawmaker Lee Seong-yoon, close to former Representative Jung, wrote on Facebook, "Why did a lawmaker whose constituency is the National Assembly come to the Assembly so late that he couldn't participate in the vote on lifting martial law? Can a cold medicine fully explain the reason?" This was another jab at former Prime Minister Kim, following a previous day's attack. In response, former Prime Minister Kim said on KBS radio, regarding this lawmaker, "I thought I was hearing from the People Power Party. It reminds me of the Daejang-dong scandal." This refers to the similarity to when suspicions about the Daejang-dong scandal were raised against then-candidate Lee Jae-myung during the 2021 primary within the party. In response, National Convention Preparatory Committee Chairman Lee Hak-young warned, "We will take strong party-level measures against the use of derogatory terms or excessive slander that undermines unity." (최고위원 후보군 인사들도 당대표 선거 ‘대리전’을 벌이고 있다. 김 전 총리와 가까운 이건태 의원은 이날 최고위원 출마 선언을 하며 “(정 전 대표가) 자기 정치 욕심으로 (정부와) 엇박자를 냈다”고 했다. 정 전 대표와 가까운 이성윤 의원은 페이스북에 “왜 국회가 지역구인 의원이 계엄 해제 표결에 참여하지 못할 정도로 늦게 국회에 왔을까. 감기약으로 이유를 다 설명할 수 있을까”라며 전날에 이어 김 전 총리를 다시 겨냥했다. 이에 김 전 총리는 한국방송(KBS) 라디오에서 이 의원을 향해 “국민의힘에서 얘기하는 줄 알았다. 대장동 때를 보는 것 같다”고 말했다. 2021년 대선 후보 경선 중 당내에서 이재명 당시 후보를 상대로 대장동 의혹이 제기됐던 것과 비슷하단 얘기다. 이에 이학영 전당대회준비위원장은 “멸칭을 사용하거나 단합을 해치는 과도한 비방에 대해 당 차원의 강력한 조처를 취할 것”이라고 경고했다.)

Party Leader to Be Elected via 'Preferential Voting' (당대표 ‘선호투표’로 뽑기로)

Amidst this, the Democratic Party's NCPC decided on this day to hold the party leadership election using a 'preferential voting' system rather than a 'runoff vote.' Preferential voting is a method where voters rank their preferred candidates in order from first choice onwards. If no candidate receives an outright majority of first-choice votes, the lowest-ranked candidate is eliminated, and their second-choice votes are added to the top two candidates to determine the final winner. The advantage is that even if a voter's first-choice candidate is eliminated, their vote is not wasted, and there is no need for an additional round of voting through a runoff. An NCPC official said, "Many were concerned that if we used a runoff instead of preferential voting, the election period would extend, potentially increasing internal party conflict." (이런 가운데 민주당 전당대회준비위는 이날 당대표 선거를 ‘결선투표’가 아닌 ‘선호투표’ 방식으로 치르기로 결정했다. 선호투표는 투표권을 가진 사람이 지지 후보를 1순위부터 차례로 적어 투표한 뒤, 1순위 과반 득표자가 최종 승리하는 방식의 투표다. 만일 1순위 과반 득표자가 없으면 최하위 득표자를 탈락시키고, 그가 얻은 2순위 표를 1, 2위 후보에게 합산한 뒤 최종 승리자를 결정한다. 유권자가 1순위로 꼽은 후보가 탈락해도 그 표가 ‘사표’가 되지 않고, 결선투표를 하느라 투표를 한번 더 해야 하는 과정을 밟지 않아도 되는 점이 장점이다. 전준위 관계자는 “선호투표를 하지 않고 결선투표를 하면 선거 기간이 늘어 당내 갈등이 더 커질 수 있다는 우려가 많았다”고 말했다.)

Attention is also focused on how the preferential voting system might favor or disadvantage each candidate. A multi-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area predicted it would disadvantage former Representative Jung, saying, "Couldn't supporters of former Prime Minister Kim and lawmaker Song Young-gil join forces to conduct a 'vote to exclude former Representative Jung Cheong-rae'?" Former Representative Jung, after attending the inauguration ceremony of Mapo District Office head Yoo Dong-gyun on this day, told reporters, "There may be advantages and disadvantages, but I respect and accept the NCPC's decision." On this day, the NCPC also decided to revive the youth supreme council member system, which was abolished in 2018, after eight years. The specific selection method and age criteria will be determined through further discussions on the 9th. Former Prime Minister Kim announced on X (formerly Twitter), "I propose a party member direct election for a youth supreme council member." (선호투표제가 각 후보에게 끼칠 유불리 영향에도 관심이 쏠린다. 한 수도권 다선 의원은 “김 전 총리와 송영길 의원 지지층이 합심해 ‘정청래 전 대표 배제 투표’를 할 수 있는 것 아니냐”며 정 전 대표에게 불리할 것이라고 내다봤다. 정 전 대표는 이날 유동균 마포구청장 취임식 뒤 기자들을 만나 “유불리가 있을 수 있겠지만 전준위 결정을 존중하고 수용한다”고 말했다. 이날 전준위는 2018년 폐지된 청년 최고위원 제도를 8년 만에 부활시키기로 했다. 구체적인 선출 방식이나 나이 기준은 추가 논의를 거쳐 오는 9일 결정하기로 했다. 김 전 총리는 이날 엑스(X)에 “당원 직선 청년 최고위원을 제안한다”고 밝혔다.)

Choi Ha-yan, Ko Han-sol, Kim Chae-woon reporters chy@hani.co.kr (최하얀 고한솔 김채운 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee, Arriving in Turkey, Proposes Upgrading Korea-NATO Defense Partnership to "2.0" (튀르키예 도착한 이 대통령 “한-나토 방산 파트너십 2.0 격상 제안”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung emphasized defense industry cooperation with NATO on the 7th (local time), stating, "If Korea's stable production capabilities and proven technologies are combined with NATO's longstanding expertise, both sides' security capabilities will be significantly strengthened compared to now." (이재명 대통령이 7일(현지시각) “대한민국의 안정적인 생산 역량과 검증된 기술력이 북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토)의 오랜 노하우와 합쳐진다면 양측의 안보 역량은 지금보다 훨씬 강화될 것”이라며 나토와의 방산 협력을 강조했다.)

President Lee, who is visiting Ankara, Turkey, to attend the NATO summit, said during a keynote speech at the 'NATO Defense Industry Forum' that day, "We hope to plan and promote more joint research programs, such as NATO's ammunition and space cooperation programs in which Korea participates." He then added, "I propose upgrading beyond the current defense cooperation, which simply trades weapons systems, to a 'Korea-NATO Defense Industry Partnership 2.0,' where we jointly research, produce, and operate weapons systems." The NATO Defense Industry Forum is an event attended by about 1,000 senior officials from governments, defense industries, and financial sectors of NATO allies and partner countries. (나토 정상회의 참석차 튀르키예 앙카라를 방문 중인 이 대통령은 이날 ‘나토 방산포럼’ 기조연설에서 “한국이 참여하는 나토의 탄약, 우주 분야 협력 프로그램처럼 더 많은 공동연구 프로그램을 기획하고 추진해 나가기를 희망한다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “단순히 무기체계를 거래하는 현재의 방산 협력을 넘어 무기체계를 함께 연구하고, 함께 생산하며, 함께 운용하는 ‘한-나토 방위산업 파트너십 2.0’으로 격상해 나가기를 제안한다”고 말했다. 나토 방산포럼은 나토 동맹국과 파트너국의 정부를 비롯해 방산업계, 금융권 고위 인사 1천여명이 참석하는 행사다.)

The presidential office aims to expand defense cooperation with NATO allies, which account for 55% of global defense spending during this visit. Before attending the forum, President Lee met with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte and held a small-group meeting with representatives of Indo-Pacific partner countries (IP4), including Japan, Australia, and New Zealand. Although Korea is not a NATO member state, President Lee was invited as a member of the Indo-Pacific partner countries and attended the NATO summit for the first time. As U.S. President Donald Trump is scheduled to attend this meeting, there is interest in whether a meeting with President Lee will take place. (청와대는 이번 순방에서 세계 국방비의 55%를 차지하는 나토 동맹국과 방산 협력 확대를 목표로 하고 있다. 포럼 참석에 앞서 마르크 뤼터 나토 사무총장과 면담한 이 대통령은 일본, 오스트레일리아, 뉴질랜드 등 인도·태평양 파트너국(IP4) 대표들과 소인수 회담을 했다. 한국은 나토 회원국이 아니지만 이 대통령은 인도·태평양 파트너국의 일원으로 초청받아 나토 정상회의에 처음 참석했다. 이번 회의에는 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 참석할 예정인 만큼 이 대통령과의 만남이 이뤄질지 관심이 모인다.)

After the NATO summit ends on the 8th, President Lee will pay a state visit to Mongolia on the 9th. He will handle schedules such as the Korea-Mongolia summit, the 'Korea-Mongolia Business Forum,' and a meeting with local Korean residents, before returning to Korea on the 11th. (이 대통령은 8일 나토 정상회의가 끝나면 9일엔 몽골을 국빈 방문한다. 이 대통령은 한-몽 정상회담과 ‘한-몽 비즈니스 포럼’, 교민 간담회 등의 일정을 소화한 뒤 11일 귀국한다.)

item.title: ROK "Pursuing ROK-NATO Procurement Framework Agreement... Foundation to Enter 15 Trillion Won Annual Defense Market" (청 “한-나토 조달기본협정 추진…연 15조원 방산시장 참여 기반”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 7th (local time) pledged a comprehensive support package of 100 million U.S. dollars to Ukraine on the occasion of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) summit. The presidential office assessed that this NATO summit served to reaffirm the commitment to support Ukraine while significantly expanding defense industry cooperation with NATO. (이재명 대통령이 7일(현지시각) 북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 정상회의 계기 우크라이나에 대한 1억달러 규모의 포괄적 지원을 약속했다. 이번 나토 정상회의를 계기로 우크라이나 지원 의지를 재확인하는 동시에, 나토와의 방산 협력도 한층 확대됐다는 것이 청와대 평가다.)

National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac stated in a local briefing in Ankara, Turkey, "We have consistently provided support through various channels, including humanitarian aid, and this 100 million dollar pledge expands our contributions along that path," adding, "As a responsible global power, the Republic of Korea will continue to join efforts with the international community so that this brutal war can end as soon as possible and peaceful daily life can be restored." However, specific details of the support have yet to be determined. A senior presidential official stated, "We will continue to provide support in other areas, excluding lethal weapons." <<> Upon arriving in Turkey that day, President Lee met with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte and then held a small-group meeting with representatives from the Indo-Pacific partner countries (IP4), including Japan, Australia, and New Zealand. Later, in a keynote speech at the 'NATO Defense Industry Forum,' he emphasized defense cooperation with NATO, stating, "If the Republic of Korea's stable production capabilities and verified technological prowess combine with NATO's long-standing expertise, the security capabilities of both sides will be greatly strengthened." <<> The presidential office assessed that President Lee's participation in the NATO summit secured a foothold for establishing a defense supply chain with NATO. Director Wi said, "Following the meeting between President Lee and the NATO Secretary General, both sides announced the commencement of negotiations for the conclusion of a ROK-NATO Procurement Framework Agreement. This agreement stipulates the legal and administrative requirements necessary for logistics, defense cooperation, and procurement contracts between NATO and partner countries. It will establish the institutional foundation for our companies to participate in the NATO common procurement market, which is worth 15 trillion won annually." Director Wi continued, "Our country, which has participated as an observer in multinational cooperation projects where NATO allies jointly develop equipment, materials, and capabilities, will now, in addition to the ammunition and space industries, newly participate as an observer in the defense raw materials project. This participation will enhance interoperability between ROK and NATO weapons systems, broadening the foundation for our companies to enter the NATO defense market, while also contributing to creating stable procurement conditions for our military supplies." <<> Furthermore, Director Wi stated, "We will establish a foundation for strengthening future warfare response capabilities through participation in the NATO innovation ecosystem. First, we are promoting the participation of our companies in the NATO Innovation Challenge, which evaluates and verifies private sector innovative technologies to be used on the battlefield. Additionally, by having our space companies participate in SpaceNet, a cooperation network between NATO allied space companies, opportunities for information sharing and technological cooperation, as well as participation in NATO-led space projects, will expand." <<> On the 8th, President Lee will hold summits with countries that have demand for defense cooperation, and from the 9th, he will carry out a state visit schedule in Mongolia. <<> Ankara/ Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (위성락 국가안보실장은 이날 튀르키예 앙카라 현지 브리핑에서 “우리는 인도적 지원을 포함해 다양한 경로로 꾸준히 지원해 왔으며, 이번에 1억달러 공약은 그 연장선에서 우리의 기여를 확대하는 것”이라며 “하루빨리 참혹한 전쟁이 끝나고 평화로운 일상이 회복될 수 있도록 대한민국은 글로벌 책임 강국으로서 국제사회와 함께 힘을 계속 보태 나갈 것”이라고 말했다. 다만 구체적인 지원 내역은 아직 정해지지 않았다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 “살상 무기를 제외하고 다른 영역에서 지속적인 지원을 해 나갈 것”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee Holds Brief Meeting with Canadian Prime Minister… "Discussed AI Cooperation" (이 대통령, 캐나다 총리와 약식회동…“AI 협력 논의”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, who is visiting Türkiye to attend the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) summit, held a brief meeting with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on the 7th (local time). (북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 정상회의 참석을 위해 튀르키예를 방문 중인 이재명 대통령은 7일(현지시각) 마크 카니 캐나다 총리와 약식회동을 가졌다.)

National Security Office Director Wi Sung-rak announced this during a local briefing in Ankara, Türkiye. President Lee had a phone call last weekend at the request of Prime Minister Carney regarding the selection of a preferred bidder for Canada's submarine program. (위성락 국가안보실장은 튀르키예 앙카라 현지 브리핑에서 이같이 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 지난 주말 캐나다 잠수함 우선협상대상자 선정과 관련해 카니 총리의 요청에 따라 통화를 했다.)

Director Wi said, "The Canadian side showed special courtesy by explaining the selection results to us in advance," and added, "South Korea and Canada will continue to deepen their comprehensive strategic partnership." He further stated, "We will continue to expand practical cooperation in the future," and noted, "During today's brief meeting, both South Korea and Canada held serious and concrete discussions on future artificial intelligence (AI) cooperation between the two countries." (위 실장은 “캐나다 측은 각별한 예우를 갖춰 선정 결과를 사전에 우리 측에게 설명한 바 있다”며 “한국과 캐나다는 계속해서 양국의 포괄적 전략 동반자 관계를 지속적으로 심화해 나갈 것”이라고 말했다. 위 실장은 이어 “앞으로 계속해서 실질 협력을 확대해 나갈 것”이라며 “이날 약식 회동에서도 한국과 캐나다 양측은 양국 간 미래 인공지능(AI) 협력에 대한 진지하고 구체적인 협의를 가졌다”고 덧붙였다.)

Earlier, Canada selected Germany's Thyssenkrupp Marine Systems (TKMS) as the preferred bidder for its next-generation submarine procurement project (CPSP). Hanwha Ocean competed with Germany until the final stage, but the Canadian government ultimately chose the consortium of NATO member states Germany and Norway. (앞서 캐나다는 차세대 잠수함 도입 사업(CPSP)에서 독일 티센크루프마린시스템스(TKMS)를 우선협상대상자로 선정했다. 한화오션은 막판까지 독일과 경쟁했지만, 캐나다 정부는 나토 회원국인 독일·노르웨이 컨소시엄을 최종 선택했다.)

item.title: Plan to First Disperse Gwangju Air Base Training Aircraft Gains Traction (광주비행단 훈련기 먼저 분산 배치론 급부상)
item.description:
As the government has designated the Gwangju military airport as the site for the Honam semiconductor industrial complex and emphasizes a “speed war,” a phased dispersal of the airport’s functions is being proposed. (정부가 광주 군 공항을 호남권 반도체 산업단지 입지로 확정하고 ‘속도전’을 강조하는 가운데 공항 기능의 단계적 분산론이 제기되고 있다.)

The previously discussed method for relocating the airport is a “donation-and-lease” approach, where the South Jeolla-Gwangju Unified Special City would build a new military airport in Muan, donate it to the Ministry of National Defense, and then receive the Gwangju airport site in return. This effectively involves moving the entire military base to newly completed facilities. This method is far from the “speed war” emphasized by President Lee Jae-myung. ( 지금까지 거론된 공항 이전 방식은 전남광주통합특별시가 무안에 새 군 공항을 지은 뒤 이를 국방부에 기부하고 광주 공항 부지를 넘겨받는 ‘기부 대 양여’ 방식이다. 군부대가 옮겨갈 시설이 완공된 뒤 기존 군 공항을 일괄 이전하는 방식인 셈이다. 이는 이재명 대통령이 강조하는 ‘속도전’과는 거리가 멀다.)

Kim Yong-beom, head of the Office of the Policy Chief at the presidential office, appeared on YTN Radio on the 6th and said, “How quickly can we disperse the training requirements currently at the (Gwangju) military airport to other air force bases? If we coordinate a dispersal plan with the Air Force, we can use this period without waiting for the new (airport) construction in Muan.” He added, “If we just relocate the airport or disperse the aircraft to other airports, the land can be used.” Essentially, this means prioritizing the dispersal of the functions of the Air Force’s 1st Fighter Wing at the Gwangju military airport to other military airfields. ( 김용범 청와대 정책실장은 지난 6일 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오에 나와 “지금 (광주) 군 공항에서 하는 훈련 소요를 여타 공군 기지로 얼마나 빨리 소산(분산)할 수 있냐. 소산 계획을 공군과 짜면 무안에 새로 (공항이) 건설되길 기다리지 않고 이 텀(기간)을 쓸 수 있다”고 말했다. 김 실장은 “공항만 이전하거나 비행기를 다른 공항으로 소산하면 땅은 쓸 수 있다”고 덧붙였다. 사실상 광주 군 공항에 있는 공군 제1전투비행단의 기능을 다른 군 공항으로 우선 분산시키자는 것이다.)

After its supersonic fighter jets (F-5A/B) were retired in 2005, the 1st Fighter Wing has been running an advanced flight training program using T-50 advanced trainers. It has three flight squadrons, including two flight training squadrons. Even before the Muan military airport is completed, options to disperse these flight training squadrons to military airfields across the country—such as Seosan in South Chungcheong, Yecheon in North Gyeongsang, Sacheon in South Gyeongsang, Gunsan in North Jeolla, and Chuncheon in Gangwon—can be considered. Since the 1st Fighter Wing is responsible for pilot training, the impact on readiness from dispersing it is minimal compared to other combat-focused wings. ( 제1전투비행단은 초음속 전투기들(F-5A/B)이 2005년 퇴역한 뒤, 고등훈련기인 티(T)-50으로 고등비행과정을 꾸리고 있다. 이곳에는 2개 비행교육대대 등 3개 비행대대가 있다. 무안에 군 공항이 완공되기 전이라도 이 비행교육대대를 충남 서산, 경북 예천, 경남 사천, 전북 군산, 강원 춘천 등에 있는 전국 군 공항으로 분산 배치하는 방안을 검토할 수 있다. 제1전투비행단은 조종사 양성 교육을 맡고 있어 분산 배치를 하더라도 대비태세에 미치는 영향이 다른 전투임무 중심 비행단에 견줘 적다.)

Jeong Bit-na, spokesperson for the Ministry of National Defense, said during a regular briefing on the 7th, “We plan to review various measures to vacate the (Gwangju military airport) site as quickly as possible without creating a security gap, but no specific plan for a temporary relocation has been decided yet.” ( 정빛나 국방부 대변인은 7일 정례 브리핑에서 “안보 공백이 발생하지 않는 범위에서 조속히 (광주 군 공항) 부지를 비울 수 있는 방안을 다각도로 검토할 예정이나 임시 이전과 관련해서는 구체적인 방안이 아직 결정된 바가 없다”고 말했다.)

Min Hyeong-bae, mayor of the South Jeolla-Gwangju Unified Special City, also mentioned the possibility of phased dispersal. Visiting the Gwangju military airport area that day, Mayor Min said, “As long as the issue of the current Air Force training is resolved, we can start regardless of the military airport relocation.” Meanwhile, Muan County, which had been passive about relocating the Gwangju military and civilian airports, released a statement in the name of County Governor Kim San, saying, “We hope that the issue of relocating the Gwangju military airport will also be pursued swiftly within the spirit of coexistence as part of this national project.” ( 민형배 전남광주통합특별시장도 단계적 분산 가능성을 언급했다. 민 시장은 이날 광주 군 공항 일대를 찾아 “현재 공군 훈련 문제만 정리되면 군 공항 이전과 상관없이 일단 시작할 수 있다”고 말했다. 광주 군·민간 공항 이전에 소극적이었던 무안군은 이날 김산 군수 명의의 입장문을 내어 “광주 군 공항 이전 문제 역시 이번 국가사업과 함께 상생의 원칙 속에서 속도감 있게 추진되기를 바란다”고 밝혔다. )

Reporter Kwon Hyeok-cheol nura@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Yong-hee kimyh@hani.co.kr ( 권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr 김용희 기자 kimyh@hani.co.kr)
