item.title: Yun Ho-jung "Even if the prosecution's supplementary investigation power is abolished, institutional design can control the police" (윤호중 “검찰 보완수사권 폐지해도 제도 설계로 경찰 제어 가능”)
item.description:
The interview with Minister of the Interior and Safety Yun Ho-jung was arranged last May. The Acts on the Prosecution Service and the Serious Crimes Investigation Office had passed through the National Assembly in March, and the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act, which focuses on the 'existence or abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigation power'—essentially the final point of contention in prosecution reform—had been postponed until after the June 3 local elections. At the time, it was expected that around this period, a heated debate within the government and the ruling party would be underway over whether to retain or abolish the supplementary investigation power. It seemed meaningful to hear directly from the Minister of the Interior and Safety, a key figure in prosecution reform within the government who has consistently advocated for the legitimacy and necessity of abolishing supplementary investigation power. (윤호중 행정안전부 장관과 인터뷰를 잡은 건 지난 5월이었다. 공소청·중대범죄수사청법이 지난 3월 국회를 통과하고, 검찰개혁의 사실상 마지막 쟁점인 ‘검사 보완수사권 존폐’를 핵심으로 하는 형사소송법 개정이 6·3 지방선거 뒤로 넘겨진 상황이었다. 당시 예상으로는 지금 이맘때쯤이면 보완수사권 존폐 여부를 두고 정부·여당 내에서 한창 논란이 뜨거울 걸로 봤다. 그 시점에서 정부 내 검찰개혁의 주요한 한 축이면서 ‘보완수사권 폐지’의 정당성과 필요성을 주장해 온 행안부 장관의 견해를 직접 들어보는 건 의미가 클 것이라고 보았다.)

Since then, the situation has changed. Prime Minister Kim Min-seok announced on the 25th of last month that 'abolishing the supplementary investigation power' is the government's final position. The ruling Democratic Party of Korea has also begun discussions on various complementary measures based on the premise of abolition. However, this does not mean the controversy has entirely subsided. Arguments for retaining the supplementary investigation power continue to be strongly put forward, especially by the prosecution and the People Power Party. These arguments typically point out problems in police investigations revealed through various cases and emphasize that only direct supplementary investigation by prosecutors can resolve them. It's a 'consistent call for retaining the supplementary investigation power'. ( 그 사이 상황은 바뀌었으니, 김민석 국무총리가 지난달 25일 ‘보완수사권 폐지’가 정부 최종 입장이라고 발표했다. 여당인 더불어민주당도 폐지를 전제로 각종 보완책 마련 등 논의에 착수했다. 그렇다고 논란이 다 사그라든 건 아니다. 여전히 검찰과 국민의힘을 중심으로 보완수사권 존치 주장이 강하게 제기되고 있다. 이들 주장의 특징은 여러 사례로 드러난 경찰 수사의 문제점을 지적하며, 검찰의 직접 보완수사로만 이를 해결할 수 있다고 강조하는 데 있다. ‘기승전 보완수사권 존치론’이다.)

However, counterarguments from the Ministry of the Interior and Safety side were also raised during the discussion of the government proposal. They do not deny problems with police investigations but argue that solutions can be found through various means other than granting prosecutors investigative authority under the name of supplementary investigation power. While conflicting with the Ministry of Justice and the prosecution, this stance from one axis of the government has received relatively less public attention. Hearing this position remains meaningful. The interview with Minister Yun took place on the 6th at the Seoul Government Complex in Jongno-gu, Seoul. ( 그런데 이런 주장에 대해서는 정부안 논의 때부터 행안부 쪽의 반대 논리 또한 지속적으로 제기된 바 있다. 경찰 수사의 문제를 부정하진 않되, 그 해결 방안은 검사에게 보완수사권이란 이름의 수사권을 주는 것 말고도 다양하게 찾아볼 수 있다는 주장이다. 법무부·검찰과 상반되면서 상대적으로 여론의 주목도는 낮았던 정부 한 축의 이런 입장을 들어보는 의미는 여전히 가볍지 않을 것이다. 윤 장관과의 인터뷰는 지난 6일 서울 세종로 정부서울청사에서 이뤄졌다. )

Prosecution reform: The problem has been leaving it to the prosecution; the 'special investigations' ecosystem must be dismantled ( 검찰개혁 검찰 손 맡겨온 게 문제, 특수통 생태계 해체해야)

—Prime Minister Kim Min-seok announced that abolishing prosecutors' supplementary investigation power is the government's final position. Having served as the chairman of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee and floor leader in the 21st National Assembly while leading prosecution reform, you must have mixed feelings. ( —김민석 국무총리가 ‘검사 보완수사권 폐지’가 정부 최종 입장이라고 발표했다. 21대 국회 법사위원장과 원내대표를 지내며 검찰개혁을 이끌었던 터여서 소회가 남다를 것 같다.)

"As chairman of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee and also as chairman of the party's special committee on prosecution reform, I laid the basic groundwork for the reform proposals. With the launch of the Serious Crimes Investigation Office (SCIO) and the Prosecution Service on October 2, it feels like the second phase of prosecution reform is finally being realized. It's deeply moving. The purpose of prosecution reform is to protect the rights of the people from the bloated power of the prosecution. I feel a heavy responsibility to ensure that the people can feel the change through the abolition of the supplementary investigation power." ( “법사위원장을 하면서 당 검찰개혁특위 위원장도 맡아서 검찰개혁안의 기본 토대를 만들었던 적이 있다. 이제 10월2일 중대범죄수사청(중수청)과 공소청의 출범으로 2차 검찰개혁이 드디어 실현되는 것 아닌가 싶어, 감회가 깊다. 검찰개혁의 목적은 비대화된 검찰권력으로부터 국민 권리를 보호하는 데 있다. 보완수사권 폐지를 통해 국민이 변화를 체감할 수 있도록 해야 한다는 막중한 책임감을 느낀다.”)

—Didn't you have separate meetings with Prime Minister Kim and Minister of Justice Chung Sung-ho for discussions? ( —김 총리, 정성호 법무부 장관과 따로 만나서 논의하는 자리도 있지 않았나?)

"We talked, but where there are differences of opinion, they don't easily narrow down..." <<> —The disagreements must have been intense. <<> "It wasn't that I had disagreements with the Prime Minister. The Ministry of Justice probably had its own internal logic, wanting to send as few investigative personnel as possible from the Prosecution Service to the SCIO even after the Prosecution Service launched." <<> —Some within the Democratic Party complain that the government's decision came too late, making the timeline tight. <<> "I also don't think this is the optimal timing. Considering the physical time needed for preparing the SCIO's opening, the schedule is quite tight. With the local elections in between, there was a choice between finishing before or after the elections. However, even with limited time, we must hurry to bring it to a conclusion." <<> —You have consistently advocated for abolishing the supplementary investigation power. What is the reason? <<> "I think the problem has been that, while claiming to reform the prosecution, we effectively left the reform plan in the prosecution's own hands. The reason the first phase of prosecution reform under the Moon Jae-in government was incomplete was due to the stubborn resistance aimed at preserving the ecosystem of the prosecution's 'special investigations' division. This ultimately led to many side effects and even culminated in insurrection. I have long believed that dismantling the ecosystem of the prosecution's special investigations unit is crucial for cleanly resolving these issues. It starts from the idea of cutting off the roots, as it prevents the formation of a power-type prosecutor group and the privileged power class from threatening democracy. <<> In that process, if one asks whether procedures for supplementing insufficient police investigations are needed, I believe we must specifically consider how to strengthen police investigative capabilities and how to control the arbitrary decision-making structure of the police. Giving investigative power back to the prosecution is not the only way to control the police; it can be achieved through the design of the investigative and judicial system." <<> Retaining supplementary investigation power means the prosecution cannot shed its identity as an investigative agency <<> <<> —Some point out that retaining the supplementary investigation power would leave investigators and investigation-related organizations within the existing prosecution, allowing its identity as an investigative agency to persist. How do you view this? <<> "I basically agree. Some counter by citing Germany or France, arguing that there is no prosecution anywhere in the world without investigative power, but German prosecutors have no investigators in their offices." <<> —Do you see the prosecution's current argument as an intention to retain its investigators and investigative apparatus? <<> "In any case, they are demanding the retention of the supplementary investigation power. I don't know if their ultimate goal is to preserve investigative power." (Laughs) <<> —If the supplementary investigation power is abolished, how will the Prosecution Service check the investigative agency? <<> "Even if the supplementary investigation power is abolished, prosecutors in the Prosecution Service can act as monitors protecting people's human rights during investigations through judicial control mechanisms. Judicial control is possible through the warrant request right, the right to request corrective measures, the right to request supplementary investigation, the right to request reinvestigation, and most importantly, the right to indict, which determines whether to prosecute." <<> —Those advocating for retaining the supplementary investigation power worry that relying solely on the right to request supplementary investigation could lead to delays in case processing due to 'ping-ponging' between the Prosecution Service and the investigative agency. <<> "I believe delays in case processing due to buck-passing between the Prosecution Service and the investigative agency are not a problem inherent to the right to request supplementary investigation itself, but rather a problem of procedural design. Setting deadlines for responses, preventing unjustified non-compliance, and establishing specific standards for the request process and content can prevent case processing delays. Furthermore, we could move towards a system that evaluates how faithfully the supplementary investigation request was responded to and how much success was achieved in convicting criminals through this mutual cooperation, reflecting it in personnel evaluations and salaries." <<> —Looking at cases like the Gwangju high school girl murder case, public concern about police investigations has indeed grown. <<> "I don't intend to defend the police's position. Mishandling an investigation is clearly wrong. However, more than 95% of all cases are probably handled properly. To address the about 5% of complaints, objections, or grievances, police efforts and institutional mechanisms enabling those efforts are also necessary." <<> —It sounds like you mean that solving problems with police investigations requires a combination of measures like strengthening internal capabilities, discipline, and oversight, and it shouldn't be reduced solely to the issue of supplementary investigation power. <<> "There are ways. I hope the party will discuss various such methods." <<> SCIO independent office building contract soon, opening on October 2 expected to be feasible <<> —With the delay in revising the Criminal Procedure Act, concerns are arising about whether the SCIO can open on October 2. <<> "If the presidential decrees on organization and appointment are finalized by August, the formation process will begin accordingly. I believe the formation can be completed before the October 2 launch. The selection of buildings for the headquarters and local offices is mostly done; budgets for the headquarters and Seoul office are secured, and they are at the pre-contract stage. Locations for the remaining local offices have also been selected considering security, accessibility, and space capacity." <<> —Have concerns that the SCIO might share existing prosecution buildings been resolved? <<> "In line with the purpose of prosecution reform—separating the Prosecution Service and the SCIO—all will have separate, independent buildings." <<> —What is the expected size of the SCIO's workforce? <<> "It's too early to disclose specifics, but it won't be an overly large organization from the start; it will be sufficient to perform its functions effectively." <<> —Aren't about 5,000 prosecution investigators supposed to be transferred? <<> "Among those referred to as investigators, some handle general administrative tasks, and some work assigned to prosecutors' offices. Some personnel must remain to review whether to indict once investigation results come in, so prosecutors can do their work." <<> —There have been reports that prosecutors are reluctant to move to the SCIO. <<> "Since the conclusion of discussions on the Criminal Procedure Act hasn't been reached yet, prosecutors might think they can still exercise their investigative expertise within the Prosecution Service. Once the Criminal Procedure Act is finalized, they will likely make their final decisions on their positions." <<> —From October, you will oversee two investigative agencies. There is great interest in how you will exercise ministerial command authority. Regarding the 'Ministry of the Interior and Safety-SCIO' relationship, you said it would differ from the 'Ministry of Justice-Prosecution' relationship? <<> "First, regarding the police, we only have general command authority, such as over public safety policy and organization, and the right to recommend appointments for senior superintendent positions and above. We have no authority over individual case investigations. For lower-level positions, appointment authority is delegated to the Commissioner General of the National Police Agency, making the police a fairly independent organization. <<> The existing prosecution had the Ministry of Justice holding general command authority as well as personnel and budgetary authority, and the Ministry had a Prosecution Bureau handling these matters, right? The Minister could also exercise command over specific cases through the Prosecutor General. In contrast, regarding the Ministry of the Interior and Safety and the SCIO, the SCIO holds budget compilation authority, and while not as extensive as the police, it also has autonomy over personnel matters. Of course, the Minister can command specific cases via the head of the SCIO. However, since the Ministry of the Interior and Safety is not an organization solely dedicated to criminal investigation, its command authority over individual case investigations will not be set up as a routine command relationship like the current Ministry of Justice-Prosecution relationship. <<> After becoming Minister last year, one of my first tasks was to abolish the Police Bureau. I want to state that the SCIO will also have considerable autonomy and will be given the opportunity to fully deploy its investigative capabilities as long as it does not deviate from the fundamental spirit of the Constitution and laws. <<> Also, investigative agencies are now divided into three: the National Office of Investigation of the police, the SCIO, and the Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials. If we can overcome the potential inefficiencies from this tripartite structure, it might also achieve checks and balances among the investigative agencies." <<> Laying the foundation for public safety through the enactment of the Basic Act on Safety and Life is rewarding <<> <<> —In this year's presidential work report, you said you'd consider designating December 3 as 'National Sovereignty Day'. <<> "After that, we established the 'Commission of Light' and discussions are ongoing. This December 3, we plan to hold an official event and make it a day commemorated as a national memorial day." <<> —The Ministry of the Interior and Safety announced it would stop using Starbucks gift cards for events, etc., after the company faced public criticism for a '5·18 disparagement event'? <<> "It's not a government-level boycott. As Minister, I simply expressed the opinion that when executing the ministry's budget, purchasing products from a company that undermines the spirit of the Republic of Korea's Constitution is unnecessary. Reflecting on incidents like the recent Baejae High School case, I thought again about the impact such deviations by influential companies have on the younger generation. Instead of arguing along party lines, I believe our society needs to find ways together to control the growth of such unconstitutional elements." <<> —You are about to mark your first year in office. What is the most memorable thing during your tenure? <<> "My first schedule after assuming office was presiding over a Central Disaster and Safety Countermeasures Headquarters meeting and visiting a heavy rain site. I feel rewarded for significantly reducing public casualties through the fight against disasters. Also, the Framework Act on Social Economy, which couldn't even pass the threshold of the subcommittee in the standing committee, is now pending in the plenary session. Enacting the Basic Act on Safety and Life helped shed the stigma of being a 'republic of disasters' and laid the foundation for prioritizing public safety. For instance, in the past, after a disaster occurred, there were debates over whether to investigate, leading to the establishment of an investigation body only a year later, and in cases like the Itaewon disaster, it took three years. With the Basic Act on Safety and Life, a permanent response mechanism is now in place, laying the groundwork for commencing investigations immediately when a disaster occurs." <<> —What will be your main focus in your second year? <<> "Coinciding with the launch of the 9th term local governments, major tasks like administrative integration will proceed accordingly, but I believe local governments must also become resident-sovereign governments as part of a national sovereign government. We will discuss what needs to be supplemented for this. The legal basis for establishing residents' autonomy committees was laid through this year's legislative amendment. Another area that has been lacking in our society is citizens' voluntary donations or volunteering. This year is the UN International Year of Volunteers, but South Korea ranks low among OECD countries in volunteerism. Corporate public interest activities are also sluggish. I want to focus on enabling residents to solve many local problems themselves through a social economy centered on cooperatives, blending resident participation with corporate social investment." <<> wonje@hani.co.kr ( “얘기도 하고 했지만, 이견이 있는 부분은 또 있는 대로 좁혀지지가 잘 않아서…”)

item.title: Korea, US, and Japan Sign MOU to Support Indo-Pacific Countries in Adopting Small Modular Reactors (한·미·일, 인도·태평양 국가들 ‘소형모듈원자로 도입’ 지원 MOU)
item.description:
The Republic of Korea, the United States, and Japan have signed a Memorandum of Cooperation (MOC) to support the adoption of Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) in the Indo-Pacific region. (한·미·일 3국이 인도·태평양 지역 국가의 소형모듈원자로(SMR) 도입을 지원하기 위한 협력각서(MOC)를 체결했다.)

According to the South Korean Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the U.S. Department of State, Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, and Japanese Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi held a trilateral foreign ministers' meeting on the sidelines of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) summit in Ankara, Turkey, on the 7th (local time) and signed the MOC. (한국 외교부와 미국 국무부에 따르면 조현 외교부 장관과 마코 루비오 국무장관, 모테기 도시미쓰 일본 외무상은 7일(현지시각) 튀르키예 앙카라에서 열린 북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 정상회의 계기 한·미·일 외교장관회의를 열고 협력각서에 서명했다.)

This MOC establishes a framework for trilateral cooperation to accelerate the adoption of SMRs, primarily targeting other countries in the Indo-Pacific region. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the U.S. Department of State stated, “Leveraging the respective strengths of the three countries in the civilian nuclear sector, this framework presents opportunities to encourage mutually beneficial cooperation among the nuclear industries of each country.” They explained, “This cooperation framework aims to create a deployment model for power plants that reduces project development risks, achieves economies of scale, promotes private investment, streamlines licensing procedures, and optimizes supply chains.” (이번 협력각서는 인도·태평양 지역의 다른 나라들을 우선 대상으로 소형모듈원자로 도입을 가속화하기 위한 3국 협력 체제를 구축하는 내용이다. 외교부와 미 국무부는 “민간 원자력 분야에서 각각의 강점을 지닌 3국이 각국 원자력 산업 간 상호 이익이 되는 협력을 장려할 수 있는 기회를 제시한다”며 “이 협력 체계는 프로젝트 개발 위험을 줄이고, 규모의 경제를 달성하며, 민간 투자를 촉진하고, 인허가 절차를 간소화하며, 공급망을 최적화하는 발전소 배치 모델을 조성하는 것을 목표로 한다”고 설명했다.)

They added, “A coordinated trilateral approach will enable companies from the United States, Japan, and South Korea to offer more competitive alternatives to meet the growing energy demands of partner countries in the region, while upholding the highest standards of nuclear safety, security, and nonproliferation as new reactor technologies become operational.” According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the MOC includes support for multiple SMR construction projects through standardized reactor designs and simplified contract procedures, the formation of consortia among companies from the three countries, project financing and capacity building, and support for technology, fuel, equipment, and services. (이어 “조율된 3자 접근 방식은 미국, 일본, 한국의 기업들이 이 지역 파트너국들의 증가하는 에너지 수요 충족을 위해 더 경쟁력 있는 대안을 제공할 수 있게 하며, 새로운 원자로 기술이 점차 가동됨에 따라 원자력 안전 및 보안, 비확산에 대한 최고의 기준을 유지하게 한다”고 덧붙였다. 외교부에 따르면 이 협력각서에는 표준 노형·간소화된 계약 절차를 통한 다수의 소형모듈원자로 건설사업 지원, 3국 기업 간 컨소시엄 구성, 사업 자금 조달·역량 강화, 기술·연료·장비·서비스 지원 등 내용이 담겼다.)

The U.S. administration under Donald Trump has decided to allocate over $10 million in new funding for the State Department’s “Foundational Infrastructure for the Responsible Use of Small Modular Reactor Technology” (FIRST) program. This funding aims to promote SMR development program activities in Indo-Pacific countries and establish a regional education hub for workforce training. (도널드 트럼프 미국 행정부는 인태 지역 국가들의 소형모듈원자로 개발 프로그램 활동 촉진과 인력 양성을 위한 지역 교육 허브 설립을 위해 국무부의 ‘소형모듈원자로 기술의 책임있는 활용을 위한 기초 인프라’(FIRST) 프로그램에 1천만달러 이상의 신규 자금을 투입하기로 했다.)

Meanwhile, during the meeting, the foreign ministers of Korea, the US, and Japan shared assessments of the situation on the Korean Peninsula and agreed to maintain close coordination on North Korea policy, including responding to North Korea’s illegal cyber activities. Upholding the principle of denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula, the three ministers also decided to continue efforts to maintain peace and stability on the peninsula through dialogue and diplomacy. Additionally, they exchanged views on regional and global situations, including Northeast Asia and the Middle East, and emphasized the importance of maintaining regional peace and stability. (한편, 한·미·일 외교장관들은 이날 회의에서 한반도 정세에 대한 평가를 공유하고 북한의 불법 사이버 활동 대응을 포함해 대북정책 관련 긴밀한 공조를 지속하기로 했다. 3국 장관들은 한반도 비핵화 원칙을 견지하는 가운데, 대화와 외교를 통한 한반도 평화·안정 유지 노력을 지속해 나가기로 했다. 또한 동북아와 중동 등 지역·글로벌 정세에 대해서도 의견을 교환하고, 역내 평화와 안정 유지의 중요성을 강조했다.)

Park Min-hee, Senior Correspondent minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Jong-un pays respects at Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on 32nd anniversary of Kim Il-sung's death... Daughter Ju-ae not seen (김정은, 김일성 32주기 금수산태양궁전 참배…딸 주애는 안 보여)
item.description:
North Korean leader Kim Jong-un paid his respects at the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on the 32nd anniversary of the death of President Kim Il-sung on the 8th. (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 김일성 주석 사망 32주기인 8일 금수산태양궁전을 참배했다.)

The Rodong Sinmun reported on its front page that he visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun around midnight. The remains of Kim Il-sung and Kim Jong-il are enshrined there. Members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, leading officials of the party and government, members of the Party Central Committee, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, the Cabinet, and top military officials also participated in large numbers. (노동신문은 이날 자정께 금수산태양궁전을 찾았다고 1면에 보도했다. 이곳엔 김일성·김정일의 주검이 안치돼 있다. 조선노동당 중앙위원회 정치국 상무위원회 위원들과 당·정부의 지도간부, 당중앙위원회 구성원과 최고인민회의 상임위원회, 내각, 군 최고위급 간부들도 대거 참가했다.)

According to photos of the delegation published by the newspaper, Kim Jong-un stood in the front row alongside Premier Pak Thae-song, as well as party secretaries Jo Yong-won, Jong Kyong-thaek, Kim Song-nam, Jo Chun-ryong, Ju Chang-il, Kim Jong-gwan, Kim Seung-du, Ri Hi-yong, An Kum-chol, and Shin Young-il. In the row immediately behind were Kim Yo-jong, head of the party's General Affairs Department, Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui, and Defense Minister No Kwang-chol. Kim Jae-ryong, who was collectively dismissed from his positions as member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau, party secretary, and director of the Organization and Guidance Department, also stood in the second row. Kim Jong-un's daughter Ju-ae was not visible in the photos. (신문이 공개한 참배단 사진을 보면, 맨 앞줄엔 김 위원장과 함께 박태성 내각총리와 조용원·정경택·김성남·조춘룡·주창일·김정관·김승두·리히용·안금철·신영일 당 비서 등이 섰다. 바로 뒷줄엔 김여정 당 총무부장을 비롯해 최선희 외무상, 노광철 국방상 등이 섰다. 정치국 상무위원이자 당 비서, 조직지도부장 자리에서 일괄 해임된 김재룡도 둘째줄에 서 있다. 김 위원장의 딸 주애의 모습은 사진상으론 확인되지 않았다.)

The newspaper reported that "flower baskets were placed (as a tribute) before the statues of Kim Il-sung and Kim Jong-il," and that Kim Jong-un "offered greetings wishing eternal life to the great leader and the great general." (신문은 “김일성·김정일 동상에 꽃바구니가 진정(헌화)”됐고, 김 위원장은 “위대한 수령님과 위대한 장군님께 영생축원의 인사를 드렸다”고 보도했다.)

This year's 32nd anniversary of Kim Il-sung's death is not a significant milestone year (a year divisible by 5 or 10) that North Korea emphasizes, so large-scale commemorative events are not expected to be held. In 2024, the 30th anniversary of Kim Il-sung's death, Kim Jong-un attended a central memorial meeting held at Kim Il-sung Square. This year, only group-level memorial events by students, the working class and trade union members (members of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea), farmers and agricultural workers (members of the Agricultural Workers' Union), and women's union members (members of the Women's Union) are taking place. (32주기인 올해 김일성 주석 사망일은 북한이 중시하는 정주년(5년·10년 주기로 꺾어지는 해)이 아니라 대규모 기념행사는 열리지 않을 것으로 관측된다. 김일성 사망 30주기였던 2024년 김 위원장은 김일성 광장에서 열린 중앙추모대회에 참석한 바 있다. 올해는 학생과 노동계급·직맹원(조선직업총동맹원), 농민·농근맹원(농업근로자연맹원), 여맹원(여성동맹원) 등의 단체별 추모행사가 이뤄지는 정도다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Koh Min-jung announces bid for DP leadership… "Stop stigmatizing and acknowledge opponents" (고민정, 민주당 대표 출마선언…“낙인찍기 거두고 상대 인정해야”)
item.description:
Rep. Koh Min-jung of the Democratic Party of Korea announced on the 8th that she would run in the party's August 17 national convention leadership election. (고민정 더불어민주당 의원이 8·17 민주당 전당대회 당 대표 선거에 출마하겠다고 8일 밝혔다.)

At a press conference held at the National Assembly Communication Hall, Rep. Koh stated, "I will create a path for a younger Democratic Party that listens to the voices of youth externally and nurtures youth internally," adding, "I will ensure that the Democratic Party, which has grown through Kim Dae-jung's perseverance and success, Roh Moo-hyun's challenges and reforms, and Moon Jae-in's inclusivity and leaps, becomes a 'Democratic Party for everyone' that represents the interests of the majority of the people and improves their lives one step at a time." (고 의원은 이날 국회 소통관에서 기자회견을 열어 “밖으로는 청년의 목소리를 듣고 안으로는 청년을 키우는 젊은 민주당의 길을 만들어내겠다”며 “김대중의 인내와 성공, 노무현의 도전과 개혁, 문재인의 포용과 도약 속에 커온 민주당이 국민 다수의 이해를 대변하고 국민의 삶을 하나씩 개선해나가는 ‘모두의 민주당’이 될 수 있도록 하겠다”고 말했다.)

Rep. Koh also said, "We must change. We must put an end to stigmatizing and using derogatory language, and instead acknowledge opponents, communicate, and seek alternatives." She added, "If we remain mired in power struggles and repeat worthless debates unrelated to the lives of the people, winning the general election or reclaiming power will become difficult." (고 의원은 “우리는 달라져야 한다. 낙인찍기와 멸칭의 언어를 거두고 상대를 인정하고 소통하며 대안을 찾아 나가야 한다”고도 했다. 고 의원은 “우리가 권력투쟁에 매몰돼 국민 삶과 아무 관련도 없는 무가치한 논쟁을 반복한다면 총선 승리도, 정권 재창출도 어려워질 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

With Rep. Koh's announcement, the Democratic Party leadership race is expected to become a four-way contest, including former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, who previously announced his candidacy, Rep. Song Young-gil, who also announced his candidacy on the same day, and former leader Jung Cheong-rae, whose candidacy is considered certain. Below is the full text of her candidacy declaration. (고 의원의 출마선언으로 민주당 당 대표 선거는 앞서 출마를 선언한 김민석 전 국무총리와 이날 출마선언을 한 송영길 의원, 출마가 확실시되는 정청래 전 대표의 4파전이 될 전망이다. 아래는 출마선언문 전문.)

Declaration of Candidacy for Party Leader by Rep. Koh Min-jung of the Democratic Party of Korea for the August 17 National Convention (국회의원 고민정 더불어민주당 8.17. 전당대회 당 대표자 출마선언문)

To brighten the future of youth and protect the daily lives of the people,
I will lead the way for a 'Younger Democratic Party' and a 'United Democratic Party,'
and guide the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration! (청년의 내일을 밝히고 , 국민의 일상을 지키는
‘젊은 민주당’ ‘하나 되는 민주당’ 의 길로 ,
이재명 정부의 성공을 이끌겠습니다 !)

Respected citizens!
Beloved party comrades!
I am Rep. Koh Min-jung of the Democratic Party of Korea. (존경하는 국민 여러분 !
사랑하는 당원동지 여러분 !
더불어민주당 국회의원 고민정입니다 .)

Today, with a sense of urgency, I have decided to run in the Democratic Party leadership election and stand here before you. (저는 오늘 절박한 심정으로 민주당 당 대표 선거 출마를 결심하고 이 자리에 섰습니다 .)

(< 민심의 회초리 앞에 우리가 해야 할 일은 무엇입니까 >)

Our Democratic Party of Korea is a governing party that has produced four presidents since democratization—Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, Moon Jae-in, and President Lee Jae-myung. It is the ruling party responsible for the lives of the people alongside the Lee Jae-myung administration. Boundless responsibility for the daily lives of the people and the future of the Republic of Korea rests on our shoulders. (우리 더불어민주당은 김대중 , 노무현 , 문재인 , 그리고 이재명 대통령에 이르기까지, 민주화 이후 네 명의 대통령을 배출한 수권 정당입니다. 이재명 정부와 함께 국민의 삶을 책임져야 하는 집권여당입니다. 국민의 일상과 대한민국의 미래에 대한 무한책임이 우리의 어깨 위에 있습니다.)

( )

Yet, in the recent local elections, public sentiment delivered a rebuke to the Democratic Party. In particular, the youth in their 20s and 30s thoroughly turned their backs on us. To them, the Democratic Party was "an entrenched vested interest that created and neglected disparities" and "a hypocritical force that climbed the ladder of social mobility only to kick it away." They saw us as "a faction that repeats internal conflicts over issues far removed from people's lives and falls short in caring for their well-being." (그런데 지난 지방선거에서 민심은 민주당에 회초리를 드셨습니다 . 특히 , 2030 청년 세대는 민주당을 철저하게 외면했습니다 . 그들에게 민주당은 “ 격차를 만들고 방치한 기득권 세력 ” 이었고 , “ 계층 이동 사다리를 오른 뒤 걷어차 버린 위선적 세력 ” 이었습니다 . “ 국민의 생활과는 거리가 먼 이슈로 우리 안의 갈등을 반복하며 국민의 삶을 돌보는 데는 부족한 세력 ” 이었습니다 .)

( )

Though painful, I believe our party must start anew from acknowledging this. In the face of the public's warning, we must intensely reflect on what we lacked and seek alternatives—that is what we must do now. (뼈아프지만 , 저는 이것을 인정하는 것에서 우리 민주당이 다시 시작해야 한다고 생각합니다 . 민심의 경고 앞에 우리가 부족했던 것이 무엇인지 치열하게 성찰하고 대안을 모색하는 것이 지금 우리가 해야 할 일입니다 .)

( )

(< 우리의 정치는 어디를 향하고 있습니까 >)

( )

With growing polarization in income, assets, growth, jobs, and consumption, the 'shadow of K-polarization' is deepening. The Republic of Korea, once divided by ideology and faction, is now split by disparities. While the semiconductor industry boom distributes bonuses worth hundreds of millions of won to some, young people cannot even find jobs paying tens of millions of won in annual salary. Self-employed individuals worry about survival, saying that doing business only piles up debt. (소득 , 자산 , 성장 , 일자리 , 소비 등 모든 분야에서 양극화가 커지며 ‘K 양극화의 그늘 ’ 이 짙어지고 있습니다 . 이념과 진영으로 갈라졌던 대한민국은 이제 격차로 갈라지고 있습니다 . 반도체 산업의 호황으로 한쪽에선 수억원의 성과급을 나눠주는데 , 청년들은 연봉 수천만원짜리 일자리조차 구하지 못하고 있습니다 . 자영업자들은 영업하면 빚만 쌓인다며 생존을 걱정하고 있습니다 .)

( )

Non-standard labor, such as temporary, daily, and platform work, has long replaced traditional employment relationships of lifelong jobs, and everyone in the unstable labor market must fend for themselves. For the majority, whose today is harsh and tomorrow uncertain, the 'KOSPI 9,000' is a story from another country—a tale that only fuels feelings of deprivation and despair. (임시직 , 일용직 , 플랫폼 노동 등 비정형 노동이 평생직장이라는 전통적 고용관계를 대체한 지 오래됐고 , 불안정 노동시장에서 모두는 각자 도생해야만 하는 처지입니다 . 오늘이 각박하고 , 내일이 불안한 대다수의 사람들에게 ‘ 코스피 9000’ 은 남의 나라 이야기입니다 . 박탈감과 절망만 키우는 소식입니다 .)

( )

Young people who find it hard to achieve a stable life even with hard work, cannot dream of owning a home, and cannot even begin to close the asset gap through labor income alone—citizens worried about an uncertain future—our politics must be directed toward them. (성실하게 일해도 안정적인 삶에 도달하기 어렵고 , 내 집 마련은 꿈도 못 꾸며 , 노동소득만으로는 자산격차를 따라잡을 엄두도 내지 못하는 청년들 , 불안한 미래를 걱정하는 국민들 , 우리의 정치는 이들을 향해야 합니다 .)

( )

(< 우리는 달라져야 합니다 >)

( )

We must change. We must stop stigmatizing and using derogatory language, and instead acknowledge opponents, communicate, and seek alternatives. To the hearts of our members and supporters, we must add the will of the people to deliver results in both reform and livelihood issues. That is how we fulfill the responsibility of the ruling party. (우리는 달라져야 합니다 . 낙인찍기와 멸칭의 언어를 거두고 , 상대를 인정하고 소통하며 대안을 찾아나가야 합니다 . 우리를 지지하는 당원과 지지자의 마음에 , 국민의 뜻을 더해 개혁은 개혁대로 , 민생은 민생대로 성과를 내야 합니다 . 그것이 집권여당의 책임을 다하는 길입니다 .)

( )

Without internal unity, we cannot expand our reach, and without expanding our reach, we cannot win the hearts of the majority. This is not a matter of sequence but a task we must pursue wisely and harmoniously together. (우리 내부의 단합 없이 외연확장을 이룰 수 없고 , 외연확장없이 국민 다수의 마음을 얻을 수 없습니다 . 선후의 문제가 아니라 , 우리가 함께 슬기롭고 조화롭게 추진해야 할 과제입니다 .)

( )

But what is our current state? Are we not pointing fingers at those with different views, obsessing over who belongs to whose faction on issues the public doesn't care about, and remaining stuck in our own league? (그런데 우리의 모습은 어떻습니까 ? 나와 생각이 다르다고 손가락질 하고 , 국민은 관심도 없는 누가 누구의 계보인지 따지면서 여전히 우리만의 리그에 빠져있는 것은 아닙니까 ?)

( )

If we remain buried in power struggles and repeat worthless debates unrelated to the lives of the people, winning the general election or reclaiming power will become difficult. That is why this national convention is crucial. In harmony between party sentiment and public sentiment, we must make it an opportunity to firmly root and solidify the Democratic Party as a governing party. (우리가 권력투쟁에 매몰돼 국민 삶과 아무 관련도 없는 무가치한 논쟁을 반복한다면 총선 승리도 , 정권 재창출도 어려워질 것입니다 . 그렇기 때문에 이번 전당대회가 중요합니다 . 당심과 민심의 조화속에 민주당이 수권정당으로서 뿌리를 튼튼하게 내리고 기둥을 단단하게 세우는 계기로 만들어야 합니다 .)

( )

Instead of worthless debates, we must discuss and communicate with policies aimed at improving the quality of life and a vision to resolve K-polarization and brighten the future of the Republic of Korea. (무가치한 논쟁이 아니라 , 국민의 삶의 질 개선을 위한 정책 , K 자 양극화를 해소하고 대한민국의 미래를 밝힐 비전을 갖고 토론하고 소통해야 합니다 .)

( )

(< 집권여당의 제 1 의 책무에 집중하겠습니다 >)

( )

Brightening the future of youth and protecting the uneasy daily lives of the people must be the primary duty of the ruling Democratic Party. In that regard, I wish to voice my concerns today on housing and job policies, which have the greatest impact on everyone's daily lives. (청년의 미래를 밝히고 국민의 불안한 일상을 지키는 것이 집권여당 민주당의 제 1 의 책무여야 합니다 . 그런 차원에서 저는 오늘 모든 국민의 일상에 가장 큰 영향을 미치는 주거와 일자리 정책에 대한 문제의식을 밝히고자 합니다 .)

( )

The real estate issue, which widens asset gaps, must be approached pragmatically rather than ideologically. This includes △ securing housing supply sites in key Seoul areas through the relocation of the Supreme Court and the Supreme Prosecutors' Office, △ implementing segmented jeonse and monthly rent measures beyond transaction-focused policies, △ easing loan regulations for youth and newlyweds, and △ comprehensive reform of real estate taxes, including the abolition of the comprehensive real estate holding tax rather than targeted tax increases. I will focus the ruling party's policy capabilities on restoring the housing ladder through a balance of principle and practicality. (자산격차를 키우고 있는 부동산 문제는 이념적 접근이 아닌 실용적 접근으로 풀어가야 합니다 . △ 대법원과 대검 이전 등을 통한 서울 요충지내 주택 공급부지 확보 △ 부동산 매매 중심의 대책을 넘어 세분화된 전월세 대책 시행 △ 청년 · 신혼부부 대출규제 완화 △ 보유세 핀셋증세 아닌 , 종부세 폐지를 포함한 부동산 세제 종합 개편 등 . 원칙과 실용의 조화속에 주거사다리를 복원하는데 집권여당의 정책 역량을 집중하겠습니다 .)

( )

The AI semiconductor boom is both an opportunity and a crisis. While an unimaginable boom unfolds before our eyes, its benefits are limited, and young people are hit hard by shrinking job opportunities. Through tailored policy design and support, we must induce and assist companies to increase new hiring. Excess tax revenue from the semiconductor boom will be directed toward youth and future investments. (인공지능 반도체 호황은 기회이자 위기입니다 . 상상조차 할 수 없었던 눈부신 호황이 눈앞에 펼쳐지는 한편 , 그 온기는 제한적이고 , 청년들은 오히려 줄어드는 일자리의 직격탄을 맞고 있습니다 . 맞춤형 정책 설계와 지원을 통해 기업이 신입채용을 다시 늘릴 수 있도록 유도하고 지원해야 합니다 . 반도체 호황에 따른 초과세수는 청년과 미래 투자에 집중하겠습니다 .)

( )

The Democratic Party must also innovate into a younger party. Rather than calling upon youth only when needed, we will cultivate them as the true owners of the party. Through a youth quota system for party posts, we will open a certain percentage of key positions in the central and regional party branches to youth. In line with a member-centered party and an era of member sovereignty, we must also strengthen the responsibilities and rights of party members. We will introduce deliberation procedures through a 'Party Member Public Discussion Committee' in major policy-making processes. A 'Youth Future Committee' directly under the party leader will be established, with its chairperson as the central party's deputy youth representative, creating a process for direct communication and discussion with the party leader. Through the Youth Future Committee, our party's youth will be able to fully demonstrate their abilities. (민주당도 좀 더 젊은 정당으로 혁신해야 합니다 . 청년을 우리가 필요할 때만 호명하는 것이 아니라 , 청년을 민주당의 주인으로 키워내겠습니다 . 청년 당직 할당제를 통해 중앙당과 시도당의 주요 당직 가운데 일정 비율을 청년에게 개방하겠습니다 . 당원 중심 정당 , 당원 주권 시대에 걸맞게 당원의 책임과 권한도 강화해야 합니다 . 당의 주요 정책 결정 과정에 ‘ 당원공론화위원회 ’ 를 통해 숙의 절차를 도입하겠습니다 . 당 대표 직속으로 ‘ 청년미래위원회 ’ 를 두고 , 청년미래위원회의 위원장은 중앙당 청년부대표로 해 당 대표와 직접 소통하고 논의하는 절차를 만들겠습니다 . 청년미래위원회를 통해 우리 당의 청년들이 마음껏 실력을 발휘할 수 있도록 하겠습니다 .)

( )

(< 젊은 민주당의 길 , 이재명 정부 성공의 길로 >)

( )

Beloved party comrades! And citizens! (사랑하는 당원 동지여러분 ! 그리고 , 국민여러분 !)

( )

The August national convention must be a time to prove to youth and citizens who ask, 'What has politics done for us?' what Democratic Party politics is about. It must serve as a starting point to present our vision for the future to members and the public, building trust. (8 월 전당대회는 ‘ 정치가 우리를 위해 무엇을 했나 ’ 라고 묻는 청년들과 국민들께 민주당 정치가 무엇인지 증명해내는 시간으로 만들어야 합니다 . 우리가 어떤 미래 비전을 갖고 있는지 당원과 국민들께 제시하고 신뢰를 쌓아나가는 출발점으로 만들어야 합니다 .)

( )

Even if that path is thorny, if it leads to the victory of the Democratic Party and the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration, I will walk it confidently. I will create a path for a younger Democratic Party that listens to youth externally and nurtures them internally. (그 길이 가시밭길이라고 해도 민주당의 승리와 이재명 정부의 성공을 이끌 수 있는 길이라면 당당하게 걸어가겠습니다 . 밖으로는 청년의 목소리를 듣고 , 안으로는 청년을 키우는 젊은 민주당의 길을 만들어내겠습니다 .)

( )

I will ensure that the Democratic Party, grown through Kim Dae-jung's perseverance and success, Roh Moo-hyun's challenges and reforms, and Moon Jae-in's inclusivity and leaps, becomes a 'Democratic Party for everyone' that represents the interests of the majority and improves people's lives one step at a time. (김대중의 인내와 성공 , 노무현의 도전과 개혁 , 문재인의 포용과 도약 속에 커온 민주당이 국민 다수의 이해를 대변하고 국민의 삶을 하나씩 개선해나가는 ‘ 모두의 민주당 ’ 이 될 수 있도록 하겠습니다 .)

( )

I will take the lead in inheriting the achievements of Moon Jae-in that have been undermined by the Yoon Suk-yeol administration and creating a Democratic Party that supports the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration. We will first build a united Democratic Party. (윤석열 정부에서 훼손한 문재인의 성과를 계승하고 , 이재명 정부의 성공을 뒷받침하는 민주당을 만드는데 앞장서겠습니다 . 우리부터 하나 되는 민주당을 만들겠습니다 .)

( )

July 8, 2026 (2026 년 7 월 8 일)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk's 'Informal Political Language': "Jae-myung, fight me, not high school students" (‘반말 정치’ 장동혁 “재명아 나랑 싸우자, 고등학생 말고”)
item.description:
On the 7th, a photo of People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk holding a placard reading "Jae-myung, fight me" was captured at a 'polling station blockade protest'. Rep. Jang has frequently referred to President Lee Jae-myung simply as 'Lee Jae-myung' without using the title 'President'. (‘개표소 봉쇄 시위’에 나간 장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 “재명아, 나랑 싸우자”는 내용의 손팻말을 든 모습이 7일 포착됐다. 장 대표는 이재명 대통령에게 ‘대통령’이라는 호칭을 붙이지 않고 ‘이재명’이라고 자주 불러왔다.)

Rep. Jang appeared that evening at the 'polling station blockade protest' in front of the Handball Stadium at Olympic Park in Songpa-gu, Seoul. He held a placard that read, "Jae-myung, fight me, not high school students." The 'high school students' likely refer to the Seoul Baejae High School baseball team, which was criticized for a 'chants mocking the May 18 Democratization Movement.' However, President Lee has made no mention related to Baejae High School. When Rep. Jang pulled out the placard, believed to be handwritten by him in his distinctive 'calligraphy style,' bystanders remarked, "That's amusing." (장 대표는 이날 저녁 서울 송파구 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장 앞 ‘개표소 봉쇄 시위’에 모습을 드러냈다. 장 대표는 “재명아, 고등학생 말고 나랑 싸우자”는 내용의 손팻말을 들고 있었다. ‘고등학생’은 ‘5·18 민주화운동 조롱 응원’으로 비판을 받은 서울 배재고 야구부를 지칭하는 것으로 보인다. 다만 이 대통령은 배재고 관련 언급을 한 바 없다. 특유의 ‘서예체’로 보아 장 대표가 직접 쓴 것으로 추정되는 손팻말을 장 대표가 꺼내자 주변에서는 “재밌다”는 말이 나오기도 했다.)

Earlier, Rep. Jang had held a placard that seemed to liken President Lee to a demon. On the 28th of last month, when attending the polling station blockade protest, Rep. Jang held a placard that appeared to be drawn by protesters and given to him. It depicted a red demon with horns holding a piece of paper reading 'Lee Jae-myung'. (이에 앞서 장 대표는 이 대통령을 악마에 빗댄 듯한 손팻말을 들기도 했다. 장 대표는 지난달 28일 개표소 봉쇄 시위에 참석했을 당시 시위대가 그려 장 대표에게 전달한 것으로 보이는 손팻말을 들었는데 이 손팻말에는 ‘이재명’이라고 적힌 종이를 든 뿔 달린 붉은색 악마가 그려져 있다.)

Since his inauguration last August, Rep. Jang has often omitted the presidential title in official settings. Jang, who called Lee "a disaster to South Korea in and of himself" (November last year), has framed President Lee as a "violent criminal," arguing, "If Lee Jae-myung is an unjust victim, then (sex offender) Nth Room's Cho Joo-bin and drug kingpin Park Wang-yeol would also be unjust" (May 12th). He has also used color theory, stating, "It's becoming the South Joseon Democratic People's Republic where the supreme dignity Lee Jae-myung and pro-Lee traitor forces monopolize wealth and power" (May 7th). (장 대표는 지난해 8월 취임 이후 공식 석상에서 대통령 호칭을 생략하는 모습을 자주 보였다. “이재명은 그 존재 자체로 대한민국의 재앙”(지난해 11월)이라던 장 대표는 이 대통령을 ‘강력 범죄자’로 규정하며 “이재명이 억울한 피해자면 (성폭력 범죄자인) 엔(n)번방 조주빈도, 마약왕 박왕열도 억울하다 할 판”(5월12일)이라고 주장했다. “최고 존엄 이재명과 친명 부역 세력들이 부와 권력을 독점하는 남조선 민주주의 인민 공화국이 되는 것”(5월7일)이라며 색깔론을 동원하기도 했다.)

Rep. Jang also omitted the presidential title at the Supreme Council meeting on the 6th, saying, "Even now, Lee Jae-myung's meal buddy Wi Cheol-hwan (acting head of the National Election Commission) is taking over the commission," and "With the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, investigations into Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party's power-related cases will come to a halt." (장 대표는 지난 6일 최고위원회의에서도 “지금도 이재명 밥친구 위철환(중앙선거관리위원장 직무대행)이 선관위를 장악하고 있다”, “(검찰 보완수사권 폐지로) 이재명과 (더불어)민주당의 권력형 수사는 올스톱될 것” 등의 발언을 하며 대통령 호칭을 붙이지 않았다.)

This has drawn criticism from both ruling and opposition parties. Democratic Party floor leader Han Byeong-do pointed out at a central election strategy meeting in Jeju on May 15th, "Rep. Jang has been consistently speaking in an almost informal tone toward the president, the head of state," and "I urge you to remember that such an attitude only diminishes yourself." It was a request to "maintain at least minimal dignity as the leader of the largest opposition party." Floor leader Han noted that he refers to Rep. Jang as 'Rep. Jang Dong-hyuk,' which he said is "maintaining courtesy toward the leader of the largest opposition party." (이를 두고 여야를 막론하고 비판이 제기된 바 있다. 한병도 민주당 원내대표는 5월15일 제주에서 열린 중앙선거대책회의에서 “장 대표가 국가수반인 대통령께 거의 반말조로 요즘 일관하고 있다”며 “이러한 태도는 스스로를 깎아내리는 행동이란 걸 꼭 명심하기 바란다”고 지적했다. “제1야당 대표로서 최소한의 품격을 지켜달라”는 부탁이었다. 한 원내대표는 자신은 ‘장동혁 대표’라고 호칭한다며 이는 “제1야당 대표에 대한 예우를 지키는 것”이라고 했다.)

People Power Party lawmaker Seong Il-jong also said in a May 13th interview with KBC Gwangju Broadcasting, "If (Rep. Jang) calls President Lee 'Lee Jae-myung,' that's quite wrong," adding, "Regardless, it's right to treat him with the dignity befitting South Korea's national standing." Seong added, "The respect for the president should remain the same even if roles are reversed; that's South Korea's national dignity. So I clearly think such actions are wrong." (성일종 국민의힘 의원도 5월13일 케이비시(KBC)광주방송과의 인터뷰에서 “만약에 (장 대표가) 이 대통령을 ‘이재명이’라고 한다면 그거는 좀 상당히 잘못된 일”이라며 “어찌 됐든 대한민국의 국격에 맞는 예우를 하는 게 맞다”고 말했다. 성 의원은 “대통령으로서 존중하는 그 마음들은 여야가 입장이 바뀌어도 똑같이 가야지, 그게 대한민국 국격이다. 그래서 그런 부분은 저는 분명히 잘못됐다고 생각한다”고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Jeon Gwang-joon light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Song Young-gil Announces Run for Democratic Party Leadership, Appeals for Support as 'Must-Win Card for General Election' (송영길, 민주 당대표 선거 출마…‘총선 필승 카드’ 지지 호소)
item.description:
Song Young-gil, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea, announced his candidacy for the party's leadership election at the national convention scheduled for the 17th of next month. (송영길 더불어민주당 의원이 내달 17일 치러지는 민주당 전당대회 당대표 선거 출마를 선언했다.)

At a press conference held at the party headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul on the 8th, Song declared his candidacy, stating, "This national convention is not an election to choose who is more ideologically pure. It is an election to choose who can earn the people's hearts and trust to secure victory for the Democratic Party, and who can cooperate with the Lee Jae-myung administration to build an irreplaceable Republic of Korea." (송 의원은 8일 서울 여의도 당사에서 기자회견을 열어 “이번 전당대회는 누가 더 선명한 사람인가를 뽑는 선거가 아니다. 누가 국민의 마음과 신뢰를 이끌어내 민주당의 승리를 만들 사람인가, 누가 이재명 정부와 협력해 대체불가 대한민국을 만들 대표인가를 선택하는 선거”라며 출마를 선언했다.)

Song appealed for support, describing himself as the "must-win card for the general election." He said, "The people showed the Democratic Party a yellow card in this local election. If we take it lightly, the next general election will be a red card. If we lose the general election, there will be no return to power. Without a return to power, we cannot guarantee the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration." (송 의원은 자신이 ‘총선 필승 대표 카드’라며 지지를 호소했다. 송 의원은 “국민은 이번 지방선거에서 민주당에 옐로카드를 보냈다. 대수롭지 않게 넘기면 다음 총선은 레드카드”라며 “총선에서 지면, 정권 재창출은 없다. 정권 재창출이 없으면 이재명 정부의 성공도 장담할 수 없다”고 말했다.)

Song also stated, "The crisis started not from outside, but from within us," adding, "Now we must show the responsibility and capability befitting a ruling party. We must be reborn as a true ruling party that proves itself through tangible results felt by the people." Below is the full text of his declaration of candidacy. (송 의원은 “위기는 밖이 아니라 우리 안에서 시작됐다”며 “이제는 집권여당다운 책임과 실력을 보여야 한다. 국민이 체감하는 성과로 증명하는 진짜 여당으로 거듭나야 한다”고도 했다. 아래는 출마선언문 전문.)

Song Young-gil, the Must-Win Card for the General Election (총선필승 대표카드 송영길)

Without the 2030 Generation, There Is No 2030. (2030 없이는 2030도 없습니다.)

( )

Respected citizens, and beloved party comrades, I am Song Young-gil. (존경하는 국민 여러분, 사랑하는 당원 동지 여러분, 송영길입니다.)

The economic landscape of the Republic of Korea is changing. (대한민국 경제판이 변하고 있습니다.)

The net profits of Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are expected to exceed 600 trillion won this year. (삼성전자와 SK하이닉스의 당기순이익이 올해, 600조를 넘어설 것으로 전망됩니다.)

Tax surplus revenues are also expected to surpass 150 trillion won. (초과세수도 150조 원을 넘어설 것으로 예상됩니다.)

The dream of becoming the world's No. 1 semiconductor powerhouse is being realized. (세계 1위 반도체 강국의 꿈이 실현되고 있습니다.)

The nation's fortune is on the rise. We must not miss this opportunity. (국운이 상승하고 있습니다. 이 기회를 놓쳐서는 안 됩니다.)

Politics must support this. (정치가 뒷받침해야 합니다.)

The ruling Democratic Party must seize this opportunity for the nation's rising fortune. (집권여당 민주당이, 국운 상승의 기회를 붙잡아야 합니다.)

The Democratic Party is not just a party competing with the People Power Party. (민주당은 국민의힘하고만 경쟁하는 정당이 아닙니다.)

We must compete and cooperate with parties around the world and strongly support the Lee Jae-myung administration. (세계의 정당들과 경쟁하고 협력하며, 이재명 정부를 강력히 뒷받침해야 합니다.)

As a political association that must safeguard the sovereignty and democracy of the Republic of Korea, the lives and property of its people, and peace, (대한민국의 주권과 민주주의, 국민의 생명과 재산, 그리고 평화를 지켜가야 할)

we must fulfill that mission. (정치적 결사체로서, 그 사명을 다해야 합니다.)

( )

First, let us face our reality squarely (먼저, 우리 현실을 똑바로 봅시다)

( )

The success of the Lee Jae-myung administration is the responsibility of the Democratic Party. (이재명 정부의 성공은 곧 민주당의 책임입니다.)

The ruling party must not stop at supporting the president's achievements. (집권여당은 대통령의 성과를 뒷받침하는 데서 그쳐서는 안 됩니다.)

It must take responsibility for jointly leading state affairs and changing the lives of the people. (함께 국정을 이끌고, 국민의 삶을 바꾸는 데 책임을 다해야 합니다.)

Even at this very moment, President Lee Jae-myung is giving his all. (지금 이 순간에도, 이재명 대통령은 혼신의 힘을 다하고 있습니다.)

We must not let the president walk the thorny path alone. (대통령 혼자 가시밭길을 걸어가게 해서는 안 됩니다.)

The Democratic Party must walk that path together. That is the duty of the ruling party. (민주당이 함께 그 길을 걸어야 합니다. 그것이 집권여당의 책무입니다.)

The June 3 local elections were a defeat disguised as a victory. (지난 6·3 지방선거는, 승리의 외피를 쓴 패배였습니다.)

Despite approval ratings nearing 70% and achievements made with President Lee Jae-myung's sweat and tears, (70%에 육박하는 지지율과 이재명 대통령의 땀과 눈물로 만든 성과에도,)

the party failed to achieve a landslide victory. (당은 압승에 실패했습니다.)

( )

The crisis came from within, not from outside (위기는 밖이 아니라, 안에서 왔습니다)

( )

The crisis started not from outside, but from within us. (위기는 밖이 아니라, 우리 안에서 시작됐습니다.)

And the solution lies within us as well. (그리고 그 해법도, 우리 안에 있습니다.)

Now we must show responsibility and capability befitting a ruling party. (이제는 집권여당다운 책임과 실력을 보여드려야 합니다.)

We must be reborn as a true ruling party that proves itself through tangible results felt by the people. (국민이 체감하는 성과로 증명하는, 진짜 여당으로 거듭나야 합니다.)

A true ruling party that unites as one and works in unison for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration. (이재명 정부의 성공을 위해, 똘똘 뭉쳐 하나로 뛰는 진짜 여당.)

And I will make the name 'Democratic Party member' the greatest pride in your lives. (당원은 이제 구경꾼이 아니라, 당론의 설계자입니다.)

(그리고 ‘민주 당원’이라는 이름이, 여러분 삶의 가장 큰 자랑이 되게 하겠습니다.)

I will achieve all of this with AI. ( )

(이 모든 것을, AI로 완성하겠습니다.)

This national convention is the first to apply the 'one-member-one-vote' system. ( )

It is a historic first step where each party member becomes a true master. (이번 전당대회는 처음으로 ‘1인 1표’가 적용되는 전당대회입니다.)

If I become party leader, the first thing I will do is create an 'AI Party Members' Square.' (당원 한 분 한 분이 진짜 주인이 되는, 역사적 첫걸음입니다.)

I will enable 1.5 million party members to express their opinions anytime, anywhere, and ensure their will extends from party policy to state affairs. (당대표가 되면, 가장 먼저 ‘AI 당원광장’을 만들겠습니다.)

I will use AI to support policy and legislation faster and more precisely, and protect our elections from deepfakes and fake news. (150만 당원이 언제 어디서든 의견을 내고, 그 뜻이 당론을 넘어 국정으로 이어지게 하겠습니다.)

I will prove, not through words but through systems, that party members are the masters of the party. (AI로 정책과 입법을 더 빠르고 정교하게 뒷받침하고, 딥페이크와 가짜뉴스로부터 우리의 선거를 지키겠습니다.)

I, Song Young-gil, will create a nation where the commands of party members become state policy. (당원이 주인인 정당, 말이 아니라 시스템으로 증명하겠습니다.)

(당원의 명령이 국정이 되는 나라, 저 송영길이 만들겠습니다.)

Give a chance to the must-win card Song Young-gil — Without the 2030 Generation, there is no 2030 Presidential Election ( )

(총선필승 대표카드 송영길에게 기회를 주십시오 — 2030 없이 2030 대선 없습니다)

I, Song Young-gil, am the must-win card for the general election. ( )

I have a passion fiercer than anyone for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration, (저 송영길, 총선필승 대표카드입니다.)

and the experience and capability to turn that passion into reality. (이재명 정부의 성공을 향한 누구보다 뜨거운 열망,)

I cannot walk this path alone. (그리고 그 열망을 현실로 만들 경험과 실력이 있습니다.)

I will unite tightly with 161 fellow lawmakers and stand in strong solidarity with 1.5 million party comrades. (이 길은 결코 혼자서는 갈 수 없습니다.)

(161명의 동료 의원과 똘똘 뭉치고, 150만 당원 동지와 뜨겁게 연대하겠습니다.)

Without the support of the 2030 generation, there is no 2030 presidential election. ( )

(2030세대의 지지 없이, 2030년 대선도 없습니다.)

If I become party leader, I will appoint two 2030-generation members as appointed supreme council members. ( )

I will create a 2030 special committee and platform, allowing the 2030 generation to directly participate in and make the party's key decisions. (당대표가 되면, 지명직 최고위원 2명을 2030으로 임명하겠습니다.)

I will make them dream of their own futures and the future of the Republic of Korea within the Democratic Party. (2030 특별위원회와 플랫폼을 만들어, 2030이 당의 주요 결정에 직접 참여하고, 스스로 결정하게 하겠습니다.)

I will not waste the golden four years of the Lee Jae-myung administration. (민주당에서 자신의 인생과, 대한민국의 미래를 꿈꾸게 하겠습니다.)

I will build an irreplaceable Republic of Korea and an irreplaceable Democratic Party. (이재명 정부의 4년, 황금 같은 시간을 놓치지 않겠습니다.)

(대체불가 대한민국, 대체불가 민주당을 만들겠습니다.)

The historical task the party must focus on most now is, ( )

through the strength of 'Lee's Heart, Song's Heart' and 'Party-Administration Unity,' to make the Democratic Party a 'structurally majority party.' (지금 당이 가장 집중해야 할 시대적 과제는,)

Not a party that gambles its fate on close races every time, (이심송심, 당청동색(黨靑同色)의 힘으로 민주당을 ‘구조적 다수 정당’으로 만드는 것입니다.)

but a party that embraces the hearts of youth, moderates, and swing voters, and further solidifies the value-based solidarity of democratic reform forces. (매번 박빙의 승부에 운명을 거는 정당이 아니라,)

I will stand at the forefront of that path. (청년과 중도·스윙보터의 마음을 포용하고, 민주개혁세력의 가치연대를 더욱 굳건히 하는 정당.)

I have experience as a regional government head, saving Incheon from the brink of bankruptcy and transforming it into a high-tech international city centered on bio and semiconductors. (저는 그 길의 선봉에 서겠습니다.)

I know better than anyone the difficulties President Lee Jae-myung faces and what is needed for state affairs. (저는 부도 위기의 인천을 살려내고, 바이오·반도체 중심의 첨단국제도시로 전환시킨, 광역단체장의 경험이 있습니다.)

A one-team Democratic Party, a victorious Democratic Party in the general election, a Democratic Party that gives hope to the people again. (누구보다 이재명 대통령님의 애로와, 국정에 필요한 것을 잘 알고 있습니다.)

I, Song Young-gil, will create a thrilling history of victory once again. (원팀 민주당, 총선에서 승리하는 민주당, 국민에게 다시 희망을 주는 민주당.)

I am someone who has overcome crises. I am someone who has rebuilt a collapsed party. (가슴 뛰는 승리의 역사를, 저 송영길이 다시 만들겠습니다.)

I am confident. I will succeed. (저는 위기를 이겨본 사람입니다. 무너진 당을 다시 세워본 사람입니다.)

item.title: Ruling Party-Government Mandates Sustainability Disclosure… Starting in 2028 from KOSPI-listed Firms with Assets of 10 Trillion Won or More (당정, 지속가능성 공시 의무화…2028년 10조 이상 코스피 상장사부터)
item.description:
On the 8th, the Democratic Party of Korea and the government announced that they would mandate ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) disclosure starting in 2028, beginning with KOSPI-listed companies whose total consolidated assets amount to 10 trillion won or more. (8일 더불어민주당과 정부는 2028년 연결자산 총액 10조원 이상 코스피 상장사부터 이에스지(ESG·지속가능성) 공시를 의무화 한다고 밝혔다.)

Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won stated at a ruling party-government consultation held at the National Assembly on the "Institutionalization Plan for Sustainability Disclosure": "Proactively managing climate and energy risks is an indispensable task for sustainable growth, and its importance as a factor in investment decisions for capital market participants is growing," adding, "This is a more proactive approach than Japan's." The initial roadmap draft released by the Financial Services Commission in February set the mandatory disclosure threshold at consolidated assets of 30 trillion won or more, but this has been expanded to 10 trillion won or more. (이억원 금융위원장은 이날 국회에서 열린 ‘지속가능성 공시 제도화 방안 관련 당정 협의’에서 “기후 에너지 리스크를 선제적으로 관리하는 것은 지속가능한 성장을 위해 필수 불가결한 과제이고, 자본시장 참여자에게도 투자 결정 요인으로서 중요성이 커지고 있다”며 “이는 일본보다 더 적극적인 안”이라고 설명했다. 금융위원회가 지난 2월 공개한 로드맵 초안은 공시 의무화 대상이 연결자산 30조원 이상인데, 이를 10조원 이상으로 확대한 것이다.)

Chairman Lee explained, "We will prioritize climate disclosure first but seek legal institutionalization by incorporating it into the Capital Market Act," adding, "To this end, we plan to push for an amendment to the Capital Market Act within the year." He further stated, "Starting from 2028, we will begin with immediate statutory disclosure, but we intend to actively grant immunities within a scope that does not undermine disclosure accountability." The government is also considering further expanding the scope of mandatory disclosure targets, including to firms with assets of 5 trillion won from 2029 and 2 trillion won from 2030. (이 위원장은 “일단 기후 공시를 우선으로 하되, 자본시장법에 담는 방식으로 법정 제도화를 우선으로 한다”며 “이를 위해 연내 자본시장법 개정을 추진할 계획”이라고 말했다. 이어 “2028년부터 즉시 법정 공시로 시작하되, 공시 책임성을 저해하지 않는 범위 안에서 적극적으로 면책을 부여할 방침”이라고 밝혔다. 정부는 2029년부터 5조원, 2030년 2조원 등 공시 의무화 대상의 추가 확대 방안도 검토할 예정이다.)

Han Jeong-ae, policy committee chairperson of the Democratic Party of Korea, said, "ESG disclosure can prompt companies to identify risks and opportunities related to climate and other sustainability issues, and to restructure their overall decision-making and risk management systems, thereby promoting management innovation," adding, "Through ESG disclosure, substantial improvements in corporate management processes can be achieved, allowing companies to receive appropriate evaluations from the capital market." (한정애 더불어민주당 정책위의장은 “이에스지 공시는 기업이 기후를 비롯한 지속가능성과 관련한 리스크와 기회를 식별하고 이에 대한 기업의 의사결정, 리스크 관리 체계 전반을 새롭게 구성하도록 해 경영의 혁신을 촉진할 수 있다”며 “이에스지 공시를 통해 실질적인 기업 경영 프로세스 개선이 이뤄지고, 자본시장으로부터는 그에 걸맞은 평가를 받을 수 있게 될 것”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lee Eon-ju Deepfake Creator and Distributor Revealed as Democratic Party Member (이언주 합성 음란물 생성·유포자, 민주당 당원으로 드러나)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea's Public Communication Committee will file a complaint against the individual who created and distributed deepfake pornographic material targeting Rep. Lee Eon-ju. The person who created and distributed the deepfake content targeting Lee has been identified as a party member, and the party's Supreme Council has voted to expel them. (더불어민주당 국민소통위원회가 이언주 의원에 대한 합성 음란물을 생성·유포한 사람을 고발한다. 이 의원에 대한 합성 음란물을 생성·유포한 사람은 민주당 당원으로, 최고위원회의에서 제명이 의결됐다.)

Rep. Lee's office announced on the 8th, "The Democratic Party's Public Communication Committee plans to file a complaint against the person who created and distributed deepfake pornographic material targeting Rep. Lee," adding, "Additionally, the Supreme Council has voted to expel the individual from the party." Kang Jun-hyun, the Democratic Party's senior spokesperson, also met with reporters after the Supreme Council meeting that day and explained, "Regarding the deepfake images and posts containing character defamation targeting Rep. Lee, we were aware that her honor and character had been damaged. We reviewed emergency disciplinary action against the person who produced and distributed such material." (이언주 의원실은 8일 “민주당 국민소통위 명의로 이 의원에 대한 합성음란물을 생성, 유포한 사람에 대한 고발을 진행할 예정”이라며 “아울러 최고위에서 해당인에 대한 당원 제명 의결됐다”고 공지했다. 강준현 민주당 수석대변인도 이날 최고위원회의 뒤 기자들과 만나 “이 의원 관련해서 합성 이미지, 인격 모독성 포함 게시글과 관련해 명예와 인격을 훼손한 사실을 저희 당에서 인지했고 관련해서 그걸 생산하고 유포한 분에 대해 비상징계를 검토했다”고 설명했다.)

Rep. Lee is reported to have suffered psychological shock and is receiving inpatient treatment following the recent online circulation of deepfake pornographic material featuring her face. Previously, the law firm Oreun Haneul, representing Lee, issued a press release on the 3rd announcing the commencement of legal action regarding the sexual insults and deepfake content targeting her. The law firm stated, "The suspect produced and posted online content that combined explicit sexual insults and imagery suggestive of sexual assault with deepfake images of the victim," adding, "This is completely unrelated to the realm of political opinion expression or satire. It is malicious digital sexual violence that weaponizes a female politician's sexuality to trample on her dignity and honor and damage her social standing." (이 의원은 최근 온라인에서 자신의 얼굴이 합성된 음란물이 유포된 것과 관련해 정신적인 충격을 받고 입원치료를 받는 것으로 알려졌다. 앞서 이 의원 법률대리를 맡은 법무법인 오른하늘은 지난 3일 보도자료를 내어 이 의원을 대상으로 한 성적 모욕과 합성물 등에 대한 법적 조치에 착수했다고 밝혔다. 법무법인은 “피의자는 이 의원을 대상으로 노골적 성적 모욕과 성폭행을 연상시키는 표현과 함께 음란 이미지에 피해자를 합성한 게시물을 온라인에 제작·게시했다”며 “이는 정치적 의견의 표명이나 풍자의 영역과는 전혀 무관한 행위로, 여성 정치인의 성을 도구화해 인격과 명예를 짓밟고 사회적 평가를 훼손하려는 악의적인 디지털 성폭력”이라고 밝혔다.)

Democratic Party Acting Leader and Floor Leader Han Byung-do also said at the Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly on the 6th, "The recent distribution of deepfake content and sexual insults directed at Rep. Lee are serious criminal acts that annihilate a person's dignity," emphasizing, "The Democratic Party will apply a zero-tolerance principle to uproot illegal actors and set a severe example so that such incidents never recur." (한병도 민주당 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표도 지난 6일 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 “최근 이 의원을 대상으로 자행된 합성물 유포와 성적 모독은 한 인간의 존엄을 말살하는 중대한 범죄행위”라며 “민주당은 무관용 원칙을 적용해 불법 행위자들을 발본색원하고 일벌백계하여 다시는 이런 일이 재발하지 않도록 하겠다”라고 했다.)

By Jeong Hye-min, Reporter jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: U.S. Embassy in Seoul: "Ambassador Steel to Arrive Soon... Anticipate Strengthened Relations" (주한미국대사관 “스틸 대사 곧 부임…관계 강화 기대”)
item.description:
The U.S. Embassy in Seoul announced on the 8th that new U.S. Ambassador to South Korea, Michelle Steel, will soon assume her post in Seoul. (주한미국대사관은 8일 미셸 스틸 신임 주한미국대사가 곧 서울에 부임한다고 밝혔다.)

On that day, the U.S. Embassy stated via X (formerly Twitter), "Introducing new U.S. Ambassador to South Korea, Michelle Steel," adding, "Ambassador Steel will soon arrive in Seoul, and we look forward to further strengthening the bilateral relationship." (미국대사관은 이날 엑스(X)를 통해 “미셸 스틸 신임 주한미국대사를 소개한다”며 “스틸 대사는 곧 서울에 부임할 예정이며, 양국 관계를 더욱 강화해 나가기를 기대하고 있다”고 밝혔다.)

In a video released alongside the announcement, Ambassador Steel spoke in a mix of English and Korean, saying, "It is a great honor to be appointed as the next U.S. Ambassador to South Korea," and adding, "I look forward to meeting you all in person soon." (함께 올라온 동영상에 등장한 스틸 대사는 영어와 한국어를 섞어 말하면서 “다음 주한미국대사로 부임하게 돼 매우 영광”이라며 “곧 여러분을 직접 만나 뵙기를 기대한다”고 말했다.)

Ambassador Steel has recently completed the confirmation process in the U.S. Senate and received the agrément from the South Korean government, so she is expected to assume her post soon. (스틸 대사는 최근 미 상원의 인준 절차를 마쳤고 한국 정부의 사전 동의(아그레망)도 받아 곧 부임할 것으로 예상된다.)

Ambassador Steel is the second Korean-American U.S. Ambassador to South Korea, following former Ambassador Sung Kim (served 2011–2014). She is also the first U.S. Ambassador to be appointed under the second Trump administration to take office in South Korea. The position of U.S. Ambassador to South Korea had been vacant since former Ambassador Philip Goldberg, appointed under the Biden administration, left his post in January of last year, with chargés d'affaires handling duties in the interim. (스틸 대사는 성 김 전 대사(2011∼2014년 재임) 이후 두번째 한국계 주한미국대사이다. 트럼프 2기 행정부에서 처음으로 부임하는 미국대사이기도 하다. 주한 미국대사직은 조 바이든 행정부에서 임명된 필립 골드버그 전 대사가 지난해 1월 이임한 후 비어 있었고 그간 대리대사들이 직무를 해왔다.)

Born in Seoul in 1955, Steel comes from a family of immigrants who moved to the United States in 1975. She has served as an elected member of the California State Board of Equalization, as an Orange County Supervisor (chief executive), and later as a Republican U.S. Representative for four years starting in 2021. (1955년 서울에서 태어난 스틸 후보자는 1975년 미국으로 온 이민자 가족 출신으로, 캘리포니아주 조세형평국 선출 위원, 오렌지카운티 수퍼바이저(행정책임자) 등을 역임한 뒤 지난 2021년부터 4년간 공화당 소속 연방 하원의원을 지냈다.)
